name: Tampere Races
description: Tampere Marathon 2025 will be run on Sunday, August 31. You can choose to run the marathon, half marathon, quarter marathon (10.5 km), or take part in the marathon relay, run in teams of four. Children have their own Mini Marathon event at Tampere Stadium. The course has changed compared with previous years due to construction work in the city, and runs mainly on asphalt and partly on gravel paths.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Raseporis 2026
description: The Fiskars Marathon in Raseborg 2026 is an exciting running event that gives participants the opportunity to experience magnificent scenery and a sense of community. The event attracts runners of all levels and is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness and enjoy running. The marathon is designed to offer unforgettable moments for both competitors and spectators.

name: Itämeri Maraton
description: Baltic Sea Marathon will be run and walked on Saturday, October 4, 2025. The distance options are the marathon, half marathon, and quarter marathon (10.5 km). The official time limit is six (6) hours for the full marathon and 5.5 hours for the half marathon and quarter marathon. The course is officially measured, and the start and finish area are at Keskuskoulu, Halmstadinkatu 2. Advance registration closes on Tuesday, September 30, 2025, at 24:00.

name: Keurusselän Syyslenkki
description: Keurusselkä Autumn Run takes place on the grounds of Hotel Keurusselkä and in the sports park, mainly following ski trails. The event is held on Saturday, October 4 at 11:00, with 6 km and 10 km routes. The start and finish are at Hotel Keurusselkä, and a prize containing local products will be raffled among runners in both distances. The entry fee is €15, which includes use of the hotel spa after the run.

images.alt_text: Ilmakuva järvestä ja metsästä, mahdollisesti juoksureitin maastosta.
Hotelli Keurusselkä, lähtö- ja maalipaikka Keurusselän syyslenkille.
Hotelli Keurusselkä järven rannalla, Keurusselän Syyslenkin lähtöpaikka.

name: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu
description: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu is a running event held on 06.10.2024 from 11:00 to 13:00. The event takes place at Ilmaristen Metsäpirtti, Pahkalaukkaantie 58, Ilmarinen, Lieto. It is organized by Liedon Luja, TUL V-S.

images.alt_text: Ilmaristen Metsäpirtti, Lieto, Suomi. Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu tapahtumapaikka.

name: Pirkan Hölkkä & Kieppi
description: The autumn season’s fitness highlight, Pirkan Hölkkä, will be run on Sunday, 5 October 2025, for the 55th time. Pirkan Kieppi, a 14 km event, is held alongside Pirkan Hölkkä. It starts at 11:30 from the Pirkan Hölkkä finish area, in the yard of TAKK’s Nirva campus. The approximately 14 km Pirkan Kieppi through the beautiful autumn scenery of Vuores and Hervanta is suitable for anyone with a good basic level of fitness. There is no rush at the event, and participants can enjoy being outdoors and the refreshments provided at the aid stations.

images.alt_text: Joukko juoksijoita lähtöviivalla odottamassa kilpailun alkua.
Pirkan Hölkkä juoksukilpailu, jossa juoksijat liikkeessä. Vuosi 2024.
Pirkan Kierros -logo. Sisältää juoksun, hiihdon, soutun ja pyöräilyn kuvia.

name: Paraisten Lenkki
description: Come celebrate the 60th anniversary run of the Pargas Run with us on Sunday, October 6, 2024. The race follows the traditional 10.35 km course, starting and finishing at Pajbacka Sports Field, which also has changing rooms and showers. To mark the occasion, all participants will receive a gold commemorative medal and a unique Pargas Run T-shirt. After the finish, coffee, juice, and layer cake will be served to all participants.

images.alt_text: Juoksija-lehden kansi, jossa juoksija juoksee polulla.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Rasepori
description: Fiskars Marathon Rasepori will be held on 20.06.2025 in Raseborg, starting from the Fiskari Athletes’ lodge at Kalliomäentie 4. The race starts at 10:00, and the race office opens at 8:30. Several distances are available: 15 km, 7 km, 2 km and 0.6 km for different age groups. The route winds through beautiful scenery along gravel roads, giving runners the chance to enjoy nature and peaceful trails.

images.alt_text: Ilmakuva rakennuksista ja metsästä Fiskarsissa, Raaseporissa.
Fiskarsin kylän rakennus ja tie, mahdollisesti juoksureitti.
Kaunis luontomaisema, jossa on vesi ja puita.

name: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+
description: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+ on maastikujooks Vooremäe kaunite terviseradade ja metsade vahel Tartumaal. Võistlus tõstab esile väljakutseid, nagu 1000 tõusumeetrit ühe jooksu jooksul, pakkudes osalejatele võimalust testida oma võimeid ja nautida metsarajalt saadavat positiivset energiat. Võistluskeskus asub uue teenindushoone juures, kus on mugav pesemisvõimalus ja riiete vahetus. Rajal on mehitatud toitlustuspunkt ning ajavõtt toimub puutevaba SPORTIdent süsteemiga. Distantsid varieeruvad 14 km matkast kuni üle 42 km maratonini, kus maratonijooksjad läbivad täpselt kolm 14.1 km pikkust ringi.
course_highlights: 14.1 km pikkune ring, mis vastab Vooremäe suure ringi liikumissuunale
Üle 1000 tõusumeetri kogusumma maratonidistantsil
Mehitatud toitlustuspunkt rajal, mida läbitakse mitu korda
additional: Stardinumber leitav enne võistlust Seiklushundi kodulehe stardiprotokollist. Ajavõtt toimub puutevaba SPORTIdent (SI AIR) süsteemiga, kiip kinnitatakse randmele. Võistluskeskuses on võimalik pärast võistlust pesta ja riideid vahetada. Rajal on üks mehitatud toitlustuspunkt, kus pakutakse vett, coca-colat ja kerget näksimist. Kohapeal registreerimist ei toimu. Ümberregistreerimine ja muudatused ainult e-posti teel. Trailrun, mägine maastik, registreerimine Stebby kaudu, aid stations, finisher-medalid, autasustamine

name: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra
description: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra takes place on Saturday, November 16, 2024, at Folkhälsan Solvalla Sports Institute, starting at 9:00 a.m. The competition category follows the backyard-style format, with simultaneous starts; the final start is at 4:00 p.m. and the finish closes at 5:00 p.m. In the recreational category, you can run at your own pace for as many laps as you like. There is also a shortened course of approximately 5 km, offering the atmosphere of a mass start. This event is a great opportunity to try ultrarunning amid the beautiful scenery of Nuuksio. Refreshments include mulled berry juice, warm juice, gingerbread cookies, and other light snacks.

images.alt_text: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu-ultra reitin kartta. Selkeä kuvaus reitistä.
Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra -juoksukilpailun kuva lumisessa maastossa.

name: Teivocup I
description: Teivo Cup I was run on 26 November 2011 in sunny weather, with temperatures a few degrees above zero. The race had 80 runners, who competed on a route that was icy in places. There was a good turnout in the youth categories. In the girls’ 11-year-old category, Mila Manninen (KU-68) ran the fastest time, 4:10. In the boys’ 11-year-old category, Miska Manninen (KU-68) was the fastest in 4:13. In the men’s 5 km, Jarkko Järvenpää improved the previous course record by two seconds, running 14:54.

images.alt_text: Juoksukilpailu: joukko juoksijoita juoksee asvaltoitua tietä pitkin.
Juoksukilpailu lapsille, mukana numerolappuja ja juoksijoita.

name: Jämjöhalvan och Jämjöhallenstafetten
location: Jämjö, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
price_range: Jämjöhalvan 21,1 km: 300 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 400 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 10 km: 250 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 350 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 5 km: 200 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 300 kr (3/10-2/11); Barnlopp 50 kr; Jämjöhallenstafetten: 600 kr per lag (4/6-2/11).
description: Jämjöhalvan is a mass-participation race organized by Team Blekinge LF, with distances ranging from a children’s race to a half marathon, as well as a relay (Jämjöhallenstafetten). The half marathon and other races take place on a fast, spectator-friendly loop course around Jämjö and can also be used as qualifying races for events such as Göteborgsvarvet. The event centre and finish are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum, and in 2026 the Swedish Veterans Championships in the half marathon will be held alongside the race. Runners of all abilities are welcome—the event emphasizes running community and clearly marked laps.
course_highlights: Loop course: 4 laps for the half marathon, 2 laps for 10 km, 1 lap for 5 km
Fast, spectator-friendly course around Jämjö
Distances are officially measured (measured 25 Sep 2021), and course marshals are stationed along the route
additional: The start, finish and event centre are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Start locations vary by distance. The half marathon and Jämjöhallenstafetten start at 10:30, the 10 km at 10:40, the 5 km at 10:45 and the children’s race (500 m) at 12:45. Runners must keep to the right and pass on the left; runners who are not running at a fast pace are asked to keep right. In the relay, teams hand over a baton in the exchange area near the lap point; late registration is not available for Jämjöhallenstafetten. Late registration for other distances is open on race day from 08:00 to 10:00 at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Payment is accepted in cash or via Swish. Start times: 21.1 km and Jämjöhallenstafetten 10:30, 10 km 10:40, 5 km 10:45, 5 km youth class (ages 12–16) 10:45, children’s race 12:45. Start locations vary by distance. There is no late registration for Jämjöhallenstafetten. The start and finish are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. The course is a loop with water stations every 5 km, in cooperation with Umara. Changing facilities and showers are available at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum from approximately 09:00. Free open training sessions are held on 17 September and 15 October before race day.

name: Höstrusket
description: Höstrusket is a trail and road race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, taking place on 7 November 2026. Choose from 10 km, half marathon (21.1 km) or marathon (42.195 km), with the start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, and features encouraging pacers, well-stocked aid stations and an atmospheric end to the running season in the Royal National City Park. The event is organised by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs, and the surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen in Norra Djurgården (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station)
Certified courses, mostly on asphalt with some gravel; 10 km: +103.9 m, marathon: total elevation gain +439 m
Well-stocked aid stations and lap support, as well as clearly marked kilometre signs
additional: Start/finish at Fisksjöäng (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station). Bib collection, pacer tent, food and coffee sales, bag drop for warm-up clothes and toilets at the event area. Changing and shower facilities are available at a nearby venue for a fee, a few hundred metres away. Chip timing by RaceTimer; pacers are available for several finish times (lists by distance). Cut-off times: 10 km 2:00, half marathon 2:30, marathon 5:30 (cut-off at the final lap point at 13:40). Minimum ages: 10 km from age 15 (age 13 when accompanied by a guardian); half marathon and marathon from age 17. Some aids and vehicles (poles, inline skates, strollers, bicycles, handcycles and racing wheelchairs) are not permitted; special conditions apply for guides and wheelchair users. The surplus goes back to sport. Registration is open.

name: Iron Backbone Ultra
description: Iron Backbone Ultra is a trail adventure in Kristinehamn built around the Järnleden and offers three distances (15, 30 and 50 km). The race takes place on varied and characterful terrain—deep forests, bogs, small lakes, pastures and old trails—putting both mental toughness and the joy of running to the test. The start and finish are at Hultets friluftsgård, and the 15 km course partly leaves the Järnleden. The organiser, Topp & Dröm, welcomes both experienced trail runners and those who want to try trail running for the first time.
course_highlights: The course largely follows the Järnleden through varied terrain (forests, bogs, lakes, pastures and old trails)
Start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård, Kristinehamn
The 15 km course partly leaves the Järnleden
additional: Three distances are offered: 15 km, 30 km and 50 km; start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård; from 1 October, places are limited to ensure a specially designed medal for every participant; organiser: Topp & Dröm (contact person Lasse / telephone 073-853 75 21), and the information pages have sections on aid stations and equipment. Start times: 30 km and 50 km at 17:00; 15 km at 17:30. No cups are provided at the aid stations; bring your own cup. Start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård, Kristinehamn. Entry fees are updated over time, and from 1 October, places are limited to secure a specially designed medal for every participant.

name: Jätten Bule-löpet
description: Welcome to the 57th Jätten Bule Run on 31 October 2026 at Bulevallen in Österbymo. The race offers an enchanting forest setting, with trails and gravel roads winding through the area. There are recreational race classes for 10 km, 5 km and 2.4 km, where everyone can enjoy a challenging run surrounded by beautiful scenery. IFK Österbymo warmly welcomes all runners to a well-organised event with timing and excellent service.
course_highlights: The 10 km course runs along floodlit trails, forest paths and gravel roads across hilly terrain
The final 4 km take you through an enchanting forest on winding trails with both climbs and descents
The 5 km course is a miniature version of the 10 km course, marked in blue, while the 2.4 km course follows the floodlit trail
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 at the IFK Österbymo clubhouse by the start area. Timing is chip-based. Changing rooms are available in the clubhouse. Refreshments, including coffee and hamburgers, are available at the start area. Payment by Swish or cash. Bulis will lead a warm-up at approximately 10:00 before the children’s race starts. Start and finish at Bulevallen, Idrottsvägen, Österbymo.

name: Panevėžio maratonas
description: The Panevėžys Marathon 2024 will take place in Panevėžys, Lithuania, and registration will open on September 13, 2024. Anyone who has registered and had a health check may participate. Participants can choose from various distances: a 400 m walk, 2.8 km, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon, with different age requirements.

images.alt_text: Bėgikas kerta finišo liniją Panevėžio maratone, džiaugdamasis pergale.

name: XVII-asis bėgimas „Varnutės ruduo“
description: The Varnutė Run is a traditional running event in Jonava, offering routes for participants of all ages. The event has three distances: 2.5 km, 10 km, and 300 m for children, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy running surrounded by the community.
course_highlights: Course in Jonava
Distances: 2.5 km, 10 km, and 300 m for children
Suitable for participants of all ages
additional: The event date is November 7, 2026, and it is a popular annual running event in Jonava.

name: 20 Gminne Biegi z okazji Święta Niepodległości
Ambla SK SV suusatajate seeriajooks+kepikõnd
description: Ambla SK SV suusatajate seeriajooks+kepikõnd on mitmeetapiline jooksu- ja kepikõnnisari, mis toimub Kangrumäel Järva maakonnas. Võistlus koosneb viiest etapist, kus neli esimest on eraldistardiga ja viimane ühisstardiga jooks. Arvesse läheb nelja parima etapi tulemus ning osalejatele on vanusegruppide kaupa auhinnad. Võistlus on mõeldud suusakeppidega jooksjatele ning vajadusel on võimalik suusakeppe laenutada. Sarja läbinuile on eriauhinnad.
course_highlights: Viis etappi, millest neli eraldistardiga ja viimane ühisstardiga
Võistlus toimub Kangrumäel Järva maakonnas
Võistlusarvestus ainult suusakeppidega jooksjate vahel
additional: Võistlusarvestust peetakse ainult suusakeppidega jooksjate vahel. Vajadusel on võimalik suusakeppide laenutus. Igale viie etapi läbinud jooksjale või kepikõndijale eriauhind. Vanusegrupid alates 6. eluaastast kuni 55+ aastani. Punktiarvestus: I koht 30p, II koht 27p, III koht 25p, jne. Võrdsete punktide korral otsustab koht viimasel etapil. Viies etapp on kavandatud 8. novembril 2026 algusega kell 12.00. Sarja arvestusse läheb nelja parema etapi tulemus.

name: Teivocup
description: Teivocup is a winter-season test-run race series held around Teivo Racecourse once a month from November to April. Each race is 5 km, with men’s and women’s categories. The second race of the current season will take place on Saturday, 13 December 2025, followed by a Christmas party for members in the Takkahuone at Lamminpää Lodge from 14:00 to 18:00.

images.alt_text: Talvinen juoksukilpailu, jossa juoksijat juoksevat lumisella radalla.
Teivo Ravikeskus logo hevosen päällä, koristeltu kukilla ja laakerinlehdillä.

name: Radioaseman Maraton
description: The Radioaseman Ultra Marathon (100 km) was held in Pori on 23 September 2023, on the Itä-Pori fitness trail at Radioasemantie 1, 28330 Pori. The route was 2 km long and ran around Pori’s old shortwave radio station. The event offered several distances: 100 km, 50 miles, 50 km as a team, 50 km individual, marathon 42.2 km, and half marathon 21.1 km.

images.alt_text: Nainen poseeraa palkinnon ja välipalan kanssa Radioaseman Ultra Maraton -juoksutapahtumassa.

name: Haaga Run
description: Haaga Run will be held for the ninth time on 8 November 2025! The event is organized in collaboration by Runner's High and FC POHU. The distances are 5 km and 10 km, and the start is at Lassila Sports Park (Laurinniitynpolku 2, 00440 Helsinki).

images.alt_text: Haaga Run -juoksija juoksee maastossa. Hymyilevä nainen numerolla 22.
Haaga Runin voittajat, mitalit kaulassa. Hymyä ja onnea!
Haaga juoksukilpailun kuva, jossa juoksijat juoksevat puistossa.
Haaga Run -juoksukilpailun kuva, jossa juoksijat juoksevat maastossa.

name: Nummela Backyard Ultra
description: Welcome to follow the sold-out event at Nummelanharju! The event takes place on October 11, 2025, starting at 10:00 at Nummelanharju in Vihti. This is a Silver competition, whose winner earns a direct spot in the 2026 Satellite World Championships. The winner receives a €500 cash prize, and second place receives €300. All participants will receive a NUBU sauna bench towel and a wooden participation medal.

images.alt_text: Nummela Backyard Ultra -reitin kartta. Hyvälaatuisen kartan avulla näet reitin.
Nummelan Backyard Ultra -reitin kartta. Reitti kulkee Nummelanharjulla.

name: Hercules Trail Run 11.10
description: Hercules Trail Run, held for the ninth time, invites runners to Porvoo’s stunning trails! The day begins with the children’s Polkuralli, where those born in 2013–2025 can run a 2 km route through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Mustijoki River. One hour later, the 7 km, 14 km and 21 km races start in staggered waves. The route is designed for runners and outdoor enthusiasts of all levels, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy Porvoo’s finest trails on the second Saturday of October.

images.alt_text: Kaksi juoksijaa polulla metsässä Hercules Trail Runia varten.
Lasten juoksukilpailun lähtöviivalla, ilmapallukoristeet ja luonto taustalla.

name: NAMI-matka
description: The NAMI run takes place on Saturday, 11 October 2025, at 9:00 at the Kyötikkälä Sports Centre in Kangasala. There are several distances to choose from: 100 km, 50 km, the marathon, and a nonstop option where you can run as many kilometres as you like. The course is precisely measured at 2 km, and refreshments are always close by. All runners are offered soup and coffee at the finish, and participants receive a medal.

name: Suojuoksun Elämyskisa
description: We are pleased to announce that construction work on the solar power plant being built at Ojassuo will once again allow the Suojuoksu to be held this year. The Suojuoksu will take place at Ojassuo in Kauklaisten on Saturday, 12 October 2024 at 1 p.m. Come and challenge yourself and your running fitness at this slightly different running event, and experience a running event like no other. Welcome, whether you’re coming from near or far, and whether you’re a seasoned runner or a first-timer!

name: Joutenlammen Jotos
description: Joutenlammen Jotos is an accessible outdoor event for all ages, where you can choose how to take part. Runners can enter a timed 10-kilometre race, which requires advance registration. The entry fee is 20 euros and includes soup for lunch, childcare during the race, and the chance to use the sauna. There is also a free run for children, along with fun arts and crafts and play activities.

name: Gdyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Gdynia Independence Run is an annual running event held in Gdynia and part of the 2026 Gdynia Grand Prix. The 10 km main race attracts runners of all ages, and there are also races for children and young people. The event combines sport and recreation, with participants able to expect professional organization and an atmosphere celebrating Poland’s independence. Photos and video footage are taken during the event for the organizers’ promotional purposes.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
Races for children and young people
Part of the 2026 Gdynia Grand Prix
additional: Photos and video footage will be taken during the event to promote events organized by GCS and the Municipality of the City of Gdynia. Registration until October 28, 2026; results, photo galleries, and information about event partners are available.

name: II Bieg Legionów Polskich
description: The 2nd Polish Legions Run commemorates the anniversary of Poland regaining its independence and offers two distances: 5 km and 10 km. The starts take place in scenic coastal locations: Władysławowo, Rozewie and Jastrzębia Góra. The organizer provides transport from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations and opens the race office on the day before and on race day. The course is available online, allowing participants to familiarize themselves with the route before the start.
course_highlights: The course passes through Władysławowo, Rozewie and Jastrzębia Góra
The 10 km race starts by the General Haller monument on Morska Street in Władysławowo
The 5 km race starts by the bust of Marshal Piłsudski on Garnizonowa Street in Rozewie
additional: Transport from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations is provided. The race office is open on 10 November 2025 from 14:30 to 15:30 at OSiR Władysławowo, and on 11 November 2025 from 10:20 to 10:50 in Jastrzębia Góra. The course is available online at https://www.traseo.pl/trasa/bieg-legionow-polskich. Registration runs from 22 September to 5 November 2025; the event takes place on routes with moderate elevation gain, starting in Władysławowo and Rozewie.

name: Joensuu Night Run
description: Joensuu Night Run 12h is run on an officially measured 325.336-metre mondo track in Joensuu on 16–17 November 2024. The race starts on Saturday at 20:00 and ends at 8:00 on Sunday morning, with the running direction changed every three hours. The event is an IAU Bronze Label competition, with women’s and men’s categories and a minimum age of 18.

images.alt_text: Joensuun yöjuoksun kuva kilpailijoista radalla. Tulostietoja näkyvissä.

name: Gränsö Trailrun
description: Gränsö Trailrun is a running event in Gränsö Nature Reserve outside Västervik, offering technical and scenic trails, coastal rocky shorelines, and some of Sweden’s finest oak pastures around Gränsö Castle. Choose between 8 km and 15 km on well-marked courses, or let the children take part in Gränsö Kids Trail (up to age 12). The race offers both timed participation and Fun Run without timing, and encourages an enjoyable experience in nature—why not combine it with a spa visit at Gränsö Castle? Welcome to experience the Västervik archipelago at its best.
course_highlights: Coastal rocky shorelines and the cliffs of Skanvik along the course
Trails through sparse pine forest and valuable oak pastures, with technically varied sections
The 15 km course has a bonus loop on Ekholmen; the 8 km and 15 km courses join at the Kroken aid station
additional: The event center opens at 09:00 at Gränsö Castle. Start times: Gränsö Kids Trail 10:15, 8 km 11:00, 15 km 11:15. The first finishers are expected at approximately 11:35, and the finish closes at 13:45. Courses are marked with hanging red-and-white tape and signs; parts of the course follow existing hiking trails. Surface: mainly trails/hiking paths, with sections of rocky terrain, natural terrain, and short road stretches. Aid stations: one on the 8 km course and two on the 15 km course. All children receive a medal and refreshments after finishing. Registration is online and remains open until one hour before the start. 8 km and 15 km courses; online registration until one hour before the start; aid and hydration stations along the course; timed participation or Fun Run without timing; start times: 11:00 (8 km) and 11:15 (15 km); first finishers at approximately 11:35; finish closes at 13:45; spa option at Gränsö Castle.

name: Mörkertrail
location: Garphyttans nationalpark entrance parking area, Lekeberg Municipality, Sweden
price_range: 250 kr för vuxna; 50 kr för deltagare under 18 år
description: Mörkertrail is a unique 10 km trail race run in total darkness in Garphyttan National Park in Lekeberg Municipality. Participants run along a reflective-marked course featuring both technical and easy-running trails, with the light from their headlamps as the only source of illumination. The race offers an atmospheric and challenging experience, with elevation gain and the quiet of the forest as companions. After finishing, participants can enjoy a grilled sausage by the fire. The start and finish are at the car park by the national park entrance, and the race starts at 17:00 on 14 November 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km trail in total darkness, with a headlamp as the only source of light
Reflective-marked course featuring both technical and easy-running trails
Course with elevation gain on the edge of Kilsbergen
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 16:00. A short briefing takes place 10 minutes before the start. No on-site registration. The national park car park has limited spaces, so please carpool. Outdoor toilets are available, but there are no changing facilities. You must bring your own headlamp with a fully charged battery. The course has muddy sections and a water station halfway. Race bibs can be collected from 16:00; sausage and a drink are included after the finish. Places are limited, and there is no on-site registration.

name: Bastardai bėga iš Lenkijos
description: We invite you to start 2025 actively!!! We’ll run in Karoliniškės Nature Reserve in several small groups, at a pace suitable for everyone. Time: 12:00. Distance: 6–7 km. We look forward to seeing everyone.

images.alt_text: Ežeras, žalias augalas ir medžiai. Puikus gamtos vaizdas.
Kraštovaizdis su kalnais, mišku ir laukais, tinkamas bėgimui.
Bėgikas su lazdomis bėga kalnų taku, Lenkijos gamtoje.
Bėgikas su lazdomis bėga kalnuotu taku.

name: Talvisarjajuoksu Rovaniemi
description: The traditional RDS Winter Series Run is back! The first race will take place on Saturday, 4 October at 11:00 on the familiar and safe Koskenkylä route. The third race in the Winter Series Run will be held on Saturday, 13 December 2025 at 11:00 on the Koskenkylä route. New this year: a 2 km fitness category open to everyone.

images.alt_text: Talvinen juoksutapahtuma Rovaniemellä, juoksijoita lähtöviivalla. RDS-logo näkyy.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 1
description: The MKFacade Road Running Cup was run in beautiful but windy weather, with 347 runners taking part. A total of 412 people registered for the first race, 233 of whom had purchased a race pass before registration day. There were 179 late entries, which caused a little congestion, but 347 runners ultimately received a result.

images.alt_text: Ryhmä juoksijoita juoksemassa tiellä aurinkoisessa säässä.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu ja -kävely
description: Forssa Park Run, which gets the whole city moving, has been bringing runners together for 30 years. Held once a month, the park run always attracts 100–200 runners of different ages. The beautiful route winds through the scenery along the Loimijoki River, and participants can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km route. It passes near the centre of Forssa, through the park at the old cotton mill and along the Loimijoki River. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of Elävien kuvien, a cinema more than 100 years old.

images.alt_text: Kolme ihmistä juoksee ulkona polulla lähellä jokea, Forssan Puistojuoksu.
Kolme ihmistä juoksemassa puistossa lähellä jokea.
Kaunis maisema joen varrelta. Silta ja luonto. Forssan Puistojuoksun reitti.
Ryhmä juoksijoita Forssan Lehden Puistojuoksussa, osa kisa-asussa.

name: Bėgimas Lietuvos karių dienai
description: The Run for Lithuanian Soldiers’ Day will take place in Tauragė on Saturday, November 17. The event will begin at 11:00 with a 600 m run for children and parents. At 11:20, runners choosing the 1.8 km distance will start, completing three laps of the 600 m course. Participants in the 6 km and 12 km distances will start at 12:00. Registration is open online at www.begimotaure.lt until November 16. Winners in each age group will receive medals and prizes.

images.alt_text: Lietuvos kariai bėga snieguotu keliu su vėliavomis.
Bėgimo renginio plakatas su kariu, nurodantis datą, vietą ir atstumus.
Bėgikai bėga lauke per Lietuvos karių dienai skirtą renginį.

name: Bolszewo dla Niepodległej
location: Bolszewo, Wejherowo County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Kaarinan Syysmaraton
description: Kaarina Autumn Marathon is run on an approximately 10.5-kilometre loop through the beautiful, flat terrain of Kaarina and Piikkiö. All distances—10 km, half marathon and marathon—are officially measured. Race headquarters are located at Valkeavuori School, and the event takes place on 18 October 2025. Everyone who finishes their fifth marathon receives a silver medal, and those who finish their tenth receive a gold medal.

images.alt_text: Kaarinan Syysmaratonin juoksijat lähtöviivalla.  Hyvä tunnelma!

name: Kankaanpää Maraton
description: Kankaanpää Marathon is a versatile running event offering participants several different distances. The event includes a marathon (42.195 km), a half marathon (21.1 km), and a 10 km run. The course is designed to offer beautiful scenery and varied terrain, making the run both enjoyable and challenging. The marathon course is officially measured and meets international standards, making it possible for competitors to set personal records.

images.alt_text: Juoksutapahtuma. Ihmisiä ulkona, joillakin juoksutapahtumaan liittyviä vaatteita.

name: Pukinmaki Run 1/2 Maraton 10k 5k
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki. The officially measured distances are 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 1 km children's race. The course loops around the boundaries of Pukinmäki on flat roads and paths, approximately 85% of which are paved. It is a fast course with only 4.9 metres of elevation gain, making it ideal for all runners.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat juoksevat asfaltilla sateisessa päivässä, Pukinmäki Run tapahtumassa.
Pukinmäki Run reittikartta, näyttää reitin ja sen pääkohdat.

name: Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: The Eurovaistinė Christmas Run stands out not only for its festive atmosphere, but also for its distinctive participants, who dress up especially for the running celebration in Christmas (and other!) costumes. This year, the event schedule has been shifted so participants can run after dark, when the capital’s streets will reveal their magical Christmas spirit! We invite you to prepare not only Christmas costumes, but also glowing accessories that will turn the runners into a truly radiant Christmas spectacle!

name: Köykkyri NUTS
description: NUTS Köykkyri is a relaxed but lively trail running event where you take on Köykkyrin Hill and enjoy good company. Expect hill training, sweat, and a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere, elf-runner style! Experience the thrill of Kempele’s “high altitude” and the true excitement of hill running, with 25 meters of elevation gain. Get ready to dash across the “summit” of Kempele, where every climb is a celebration and every descent deserves applause.

images.alt_text: NUTS Köykkyri polkujuoksukilpailun kuva. Juoksijat juoksevat metsäpolulla.
NUTS Köykkyri -polkujuoksun reitti kartalla. Viisi eri lenkkiä.

name: Mustaschmilen Stockholm
description:
Mustaschmilen takes place at Solvalla in Stockholm, where the horses make way for runners for a day. We’re looking forward to a festival on November 21. We’ll fill the stadium with runners of all ages and welcome you whether you’re an elite runner or a recreational runner. Together with the spectators, sponsors, and activities, we’ll make it an unforgettable arena experience.

Mustaschmilen in Stockholm has three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and 1 km for children. The two longer races will be run on a loop course filled with upbeat music and an enthusiastic announcer along the 1,000-meter course.
additional:
10:00 – Bib pickup opens
Make sure to pick up your bib well before the start.
11:00 – 5 km start, all paces
12:15 – Children’s race start, 1 km
12:45 – 10 km start, race
14:00 – 10 km start, recreational

Runacademy will lead a group warm-up approximately 10 minutes before each start.

name: VC TRAIL 2026-11-21 FINALINIS ETAPAS
description: Vilnius Challenge is a unique multisport event held since 2009, giving participants the opportunity to test their physical and psychological limits on a variety of courses. The event includes running, cycling, orienteering, and special physical challenges, offering an adventure in Vilnius’s urban and natural surroundings. Participants can choose a course level to suit their ability, from amateur to extreme courses with a range of obstacles. Vilnius Challenge promotes a healthy lifestyle, teamwork, and community spirit, bringing together sports enthusiasts and people who enjoy an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course includes running, cycling, orienteering, and physical challenges
Participants can choose a course level: amateur, challenge, or extreme
The extreme course features climbing, crawling, swimming, and rappelling
additional: The event centre is the main event venue, where registration, the start, and the finish take place. Participants receive information about the programme and other important details by email in stages. Start times and participant flow may be managed in waves for safety. The event programme and courses may be adjusted for objective reasons. Trail running event with courses at several levels; registration is required. Event date: November 21, 2026.

name: Botaniczna Piątka – Gdynia, edycja jesienna
location: Botaniczny Ogród w Gdyni, Gdynia, Poland

name: Bėgimas Atgal į Praeitį
location: Vilnius, Laisvalaikio erdvė prie Baltojo tilto
description: Running Back to the Past is a unique event where history becomes the present. All the award medals, trophies, and prizes from previous years’ races are given a second life and new meaning, symbolizing the bond within the running community. The essence of the event is not the novelty of the trophies, but the joy of running and the opportunity to rediscover the meaning of sport. Every participant who completes the full marathon distance will receive a Saulėtekis Marathon neck gaiter.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo varžybų startas. Bėgikai po starto linija. Arka su asociacijos pavadinimu ir logotipu.

name: Lepokallion Lenkki Polkujuoksu
description: Lepokallion Lenkki trail run will be held in Ylistaro on Saturday, November 2, at 11:00. The event offers varied terrain amid beautiful scenery, with trails and natural areas providing runners with stunning views and challenges. Several distances are available, including 5.6 km and 10.8 km, suitable for both beginners and more experienced runners.

name: Sarvilahden Maraton
description: The Sarvilahti Marathon will be held on 25 October 2025 at Rauhala Park in Loviisa. The event offers several races, including a marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, as well as a 1.6 km children’s course. The marathon consists of two laps of an officially measured half-marathon course. Parking is at the Loviisa Ice Hall, with signs directing participants to the start in the park, about 400 metres away.

images.alt_text: Ryhmä juoksijoita juoksee kilpailussa, jossa on numeroituja kilpailijoita.

name: Helsinki Halloween Run
description: Helsinki Halloween Run is a relaxed Halloween-themed running event for runners of all levels. In 2025, the event takes place on October 25 in Kalasatama, Helsinki! The new route winds through Kalasatama’s urban surroundings and consists of a 5 km loop, run once for the 5 km race and twice for the 10 km race. You can take part competitively against the clock or dress up in your most outrageous Halloween costume.

images.alt_text: Helsingin Halloween-juoksussa osallistujat mime-asussa. Hauska kuva!

name: Tuusula Trailrun
description: Tuusula Trailrun 2024 is a trail running race held on Sunday, 27 October 2024 at 11:00 at the biathlon stadium of Tuusula Sports Centre. The race course winds along the trails of Tuusula Korpikylä and Sammaloja and is marked with blue-and-yellow tape and signs. The entry fee includes the trail race, chip timing, a hot soup and a drink, and access to shower facilities at the ice rink.

images.alt_text: Ryhmä juoksijoita juoksemassa asfaltilla, metsä taustalla.

name: Hiidenhölkkä Nummela
description: As autumn approaches, so does the traditional Hiidenhölkkä, organized this year for the 47th time by Nummelan Tarmo. The Hiidenhölkkä routes—the 10 km and 20 km (2 × 10 km) runs—loop around Nummelanharju and Nummela Airport. Hiidenhölkkä starts at 12:00 and the running event ends at 14:00.

name: Temple x Nike Winterized Challenge
description: The “Nike Winterized Challenge” with Temple Social is your motivation boost for the cold season. Keep running when the days get shorter and the weather gets colder. Join the Nike and Temple Social running community—we’ll run for 4 weeks, twice a week. Every step counts—earn points, and Nike will reward you with discounts and gifts. Four of you will have the chance to win the new VOMERO GORE-TEX!

name: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp
location: Gummiverkstaden, Bankekind, Linköping Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Team Fillinge Ultra’s trail race is a friendly, local event organized by Team Fillinge Ultra. The race is approximately 10 km long and consists mostly of scenic gravel roads and lovely trails just outside Fillinge, south of Bankekind/Linköping. The event is being held for the second year and has a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere for trail runners who want to enjoy nature. Meet at Gummiverkstaden (gathering at 10:40); the race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km
Mostly scenic gravel roads and lovely forest trails
Gathering and start at Gummiverkstaden, south of Bankekind (near Fillinge/Linköping)
additional: Information meeting at 10:40 at Gummiverkstaden; start at 11:00. The race is organized by Team Fillinge Ultra (contact: marcuslundin@gmail.com). Website operator/event partner: Trailrunning Sweden AB (info@trailrunningsweden.se). New course route for 2025 and all 100 entries sold out one week before the race; new hiking prize “The Golden Toaster”; logistics information includes a bus from Linköping toward Åtvidaberg (get off at Sandtorp) and parking at Gummiverkstaden (limited space; carpooling encouraged).

name: Hammarby Alpin Marathon
location: Vindskyddet i Barnbacken, Hammarbybacken, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Hammarby Alpin Marathon is a unique alpine marathon in the heart of Stockholm, running up, over and around Hammarbybacken. The race consists of 22 laps and is slightly longer than a standard marathon—a microultra that, in the organiser’s words, could also be called Sweden’s probably slowest marathon. The course is technical and spectator-friendly, with the lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope. The event is a festive Advent celebration organised by Stockholm Multisportklubb.
course_highlights: 22 laps around Hammarbybacken (start, lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope)
Start at the bottom of the hill (to the left of the lift when facing the summit) and climb over the “Trysil” section by the jetty
Technical sections: down along the service road, around the chimney, through Indianparken, inside the allotment gardens and along the cycle path
additional: Organiser: Stockholm Multisportklubb. Registration takes place at the lap point/finish (the shelter in the children’s slope). Nearest metro station: Hammarbyhöjden. Start location: at the bottom of the hill, to the left of the lift. Registration is via RaceID, according to the registration page. Registration and finish are at the shelter in the children’s slope; bags can be left at the foot of the hill; a tarpaulin is provided in case of rain; toilets are behind the car park; the right of public access applies; results are published after the race (top 10 faster).

name: Saulėtekio maratonas
description: Saulėtekio Marathon 2025 will take place on December 14, 2025, in Vilnius at the VGTU sports complex, Saulėtekio Ave. 28. Several distances will be offered: a 600 m “children’s run,” 4.2 km, 12.6 km, a half marathon (21.1 km), and a marathon (42.2 km). Participants can compete in various age groups, and winners will receive trophies and prizes. The Saulėtekio Marathon slogan: YOUR ONLY LIMIT IS YOU!!!

images.alt_text: Saulėtekio maratono reklama su bėgančiu žmogumi saulėlydyje.
Bėgikai bėga gatve. Viršuje oranžinis arkos vartai. Gausybė žmonių bėga.
Vilniaus maratonas 2023. Bėgikai gatvėje, renginio vieta.

name: Adventsjoggen
description:
Experience a magical start to the festive season with Adventsjoggen at Stora Hjortstorps Gård in Örebro on 29 November! Bring your friends, family or colleagues for a day filled with exercise, community and delicious food. Choose between a scenic 7.2 km or a challenging 15 km. There’s also a 600 m Kidsrun for the youngest participants.

After the race, a warming reward awaits: hearty goulash and freshly baked bread, all included in the entry fee! The course takes you through beautiful surroundings, starting and finishing at the farm, along idyllic landscapes past Rävgången and Naturens Hus.

name: Järvenpään Maraton
description: The Järvenpää Marathon has been held since 1994. The half marathon and marathon courses are officially measured and run mainly on a paved shared-use path around Lake Tuusula. For the first time, the route follows Tuusula’s Rantatie, offering cultural experiences for both runners and spectators. The area has excellent transport connections, and there is plenty of parking nearby. Welcome to Tuusula and Järvenpää!

name: Trail Start: Nemokama Bėgimo Treniruotė
location: Vingio parko lauko treniruoklių sporto aikštelė
description: Trail START. A free running workout with Monika Mile will take place on December 2 (Tuesday) at 18:30 at the outdoor fitness equipment area in Vingis Park. The workout will last about 1 hour and cover approximately 5 km at an easy pace. It is aimed at beginners who want to learn to run confidently in the forest. The focus will be on technique, feel, and safety in the forest. You must bring running shoes with good tread, weather-appropriate clothing, a headlamp, and a good mood.

name: Advento bėgimo iššūkis 2026
description: The Advent Running Challenge 2026 is a virtual event taking place from December 1 to 24. Participants receive a new task each day, involving running, physical, accuracy, and creative challenges. The challenge encourages not only speed, but also perseverance, creativity, and engagement throughout all 24 days. Participants compete for the title of Advent Champion and receive a participant kit, with the chance to win prizes from the prize fund.
course_highlights: 24 days with 24 different tasks
Physical, accuracy, and creative challenges
A virtual running challenge with the opportunity to earn points and compete
additional: A participant kit for every participant. Prize fund: €175 (may increase depending on the number of participants). A 24-day challenge with tasks, prizes, and registration via a Google Form.

name: Night Shift Trail - Växjö
location: Shooting range parking area, Notteryd, Växjö, Sweden
description: Night.Shift Trailrun Växjö is a trail running event held in scenic surroundings by the shooting range car park in Notteryd, Växjö. The event focuses on a unique experience in technical and challenging terrain rather than competition and prizes. The organisers place great emphasis on community and purpose, with a large part of the entry fee going to charity. The event is part of the Mossarun events, run by a group of friends with a passion for trails and nature.
course_highlights: Technical and challenging trails in scenic surroundings
Running across varied terrain, including forest and hilly sections
Focus on the experience and community rather than competition
additional: The event is run on a non-profit basis, and a large part of the proceeds goes to the Sangter Foundation, which helps people in Sikkim, India. The focus is on small events with few participants to create a personal and meaningful experience. Previous Mossarun events have included various distances and formats, including ultra and Backyard Ultra. The organisers are open to collaborations and innovative event ideas. The start and finish are near the shooting range car park in Notteryd. Start waves are listed as 17.30–18.00 and 19.00–19.30. Participants receive a start chip and check out and back in to record their lap time. Food and non-alcoholic beer are served after the race.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is an exceptional trail race taking place on 5 December 2026 in the picturesque Tricity Landscape Park. The course combines a seaside atmosphere with varied, mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging climbs, valleys, ravines and gorges. It is a great opportunity to end the season amid sporting competition and close contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Tricity Landscape Park, close to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, ravines and gorges
Challenging elevation gains and natural climbs characteristic of trail running
additional: Race packs can be collected on 4–5 December 2026 at the race office. Starts are held in waves: the 6 km night race starts at 19:00 on 4 December; on 5 December, the 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30) and 12 km (13:30) races start, along with Garmin Junior races for children. Time limits for completing the distances range from 2 to 15 hours, depending on course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The participant card is available 5 days before the race after logging in to startlist.pl. Distances from 12 km to 86 km, time limits, qualifying points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and young people.

name: EUROVAISTINĖS Kalėdinis bėgimas
description: EUROVAISTINĖS Christmas Run 2024—the most beautiful winter run, welcoming Christmas and spending time filled with unforgettable emotions and the captivating energy of running! WE RUN on December 7, 2024, in Vilnius. The event stands out for its festive atmosphere and participants dressed in Christmas costumes with glowing accents. This year, participants can run after dark, when the capital’s streets reveal a truly sparkling and magical Christmas spirit.

images.alt_text: Senelis Kalėda su maišu prie eglutės.
Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas 2024. Šventinis bėgimas Vilniuje.
Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas 2023 metų logotipas su kalėdiniais elementais.

name: Edgaro atminimui Bėgimas
description: On October 18, we invite everyone to the 11th annual “In Memoriam” run, held to honor the memory of soldiers who died this year. All funds donated during the run will support the families of deceased Lithuanian soldiers. Two championship distances are dedicated to the memory of Lithuanian sports legends: the Felicija Karoblienė Cup (2,000 m for girls) and the Jonas Pipynė Cup (5,000 m for boys).

name: Itsenäisyysmaraton
description: In 2025, Itsenäisyysmaraton celebrates its 44th year and will be held on Saturday, 06.12, in Kuopio at Väinölänniemi. Several distances are offered, including the marathon, half marathon, minimarathon, and the Kultajousi Running 10 km and 5 km races. The route is 5.27 km long, flat, and runs on sand and asphalt. A refreshment station provides runners with water and juice. Participants can register in advance or on race day.

name: Backyardish Ultra
description: Backyardish Ultra Kuopio follows the traditional backyard ultra format, but it is not an official backyard ultra. The route is a marked loop of approximately 6.7 kilometres through the forest. The event takes place in Neulamäki on Saturday, 16 November 2024, from 9:00 to 21:00. All participants start their first lap at 9:00, and subsequent laps start on the hour. The winner is the first person to finish the final lap. There is no winner if nobody completes the final lap.

images.alt_text: Metsässä juoksevia ihmisiä polulla, juoksukilpailuun liittyvä kuva.

name: Kauno SK Nemunas 1000 m
description: The Kaunas SK „Nemunas” 1000 m Race Cup will take place on December 14, 2024, in Kaunas. On Saturday, 127 runners competed in the 1000 m event. The top places went to the Youth category: Simas Gedeikis (Kaunas) with a time of 2:38.62 and Viltė Bubinaitė (Vilnius) with 3:04.08. Juniors, younger juniors, and children also took part and achieved excellent results.

images.alt_text: Bėgikas lenktynėse su numeriu 49, SK Nemunas apranga.
1000 m bėgimo varžybų nugalėtojai ant pakylos.
Jauni bėgikai su medaliais ir dovanomis ant podiumo.
Dvi mergaitės po bėgimo su medaliais.

name: Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė is a Backyard Ultra race designed to help runners cover the 100-mile distance as easily as possible. If you’ve never received a DNF in your life, here’s your chance to earn one with honor. There will be only one winner, so get ready for a challenge in Alytus.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 2/5
description: Finland’s largest road running series, Vantaa Road Running Cup, starts again on Saturday at Sotunki School, which returns as the event centre after a few years’ break. The event has a 32-year history, and this year’s new main sponsor is MK FACADE OY. On Saturday, runners will compete over 5 km and 10 km, with starts at 13:00 and 13:10. The route is designed to provide runners with a pleasant and safe environment, and enhanced supervision will ensure safety during the race.

images.alt_text: Juoksukilpailu Vantaalla, jossa joukko ihmisiä juoksee asfaltilla. Taustalla rakennuksia ja puita.

name: Talvisarjajuoksu Rovaniemi
description: The traditional RDS Winter Series Run is back! The first race will take place on Saturday, 4 October at 11:00 on the familiar and safe Koskenkylä route. The third race in the Winter Series will be run on Saturday, 13 December 2025 at 11:00 on the Koskenkylä route. New this year: a 2 km fitness race open to everyone.

name: Teivocup II
description: Teivocup is a winter-season series of test runs, offering the opportunity to take part in running races at all levels, from recreational runners to competitive athletes. The event is held in Ylöjärvi, near the Teivo Race Centre, and is aimed at everyone who enjoys endurance sports. Each race is 5 km, and runners can register on site. The entry fee is €10 per race (€7 for club members). The second race will take place on Saturday, 13 December 2025, followed by a Christmas party for members at Lamminpää Lodge.

name: Santa Fun Run Šiauliai
description: The Santa Fun Run is a lovely tradition for Šiauliai residents and visitors, with nearly 500 participants dressed as Santa Claus running through the city streets. The run has a noble purpose: all funds raised go to charity. There are no age restrictions, and everyone can easily complete the symbolic 1.3 km distance. At the finish, participants will be in for a surprise: one of Lithuania’s best-known performers, Jovani, will greet the running Santas.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run is an event that gets the whole city moving and has been bringing runners together for 30 years. Held once a month, it typically attracts 100–200 runners of all ages. The beautiful route winds through the scenery along the Loimijoki River. Runners can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km course, which passes near Forssa city centre through the park of the old cotton mill. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of the more than 100-year-old Elävien Kuvien cinema.

images.alt_text: Kolme juoksijaa Forssan Puistojuoksussa kauniilla reitillä.
Forssan Puistojuoksun 2024 kausikortti. Juoksijoita ja aikataulu.
Forssan Puistojuoksun kausikortti 2023. Juoksijoita ja kilpailukalenteri.

name: 2026 Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev
location: Rocca al Mare kool, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev on traditsiooniline talvine jooksuüritus, mis toimub 19. detsembril 2026 Tallinnas Rocca al Mare kooli ees. Võistluskeskus ja start-finiš paiknevad mugavalt kooli juures ning kavas on kolm distantsi: maraton, teatemaraton ja 8,4 km jooks. Rajad kulgevad peamiselt kergliiklusteedel, olles hästi tähistatud ja turvalised, pakkudes sportlikku võimalust aasta lõpetamiseks. Osalejatele on tagatud meditsiiniline abi, ajavõtt, medalid ning soe tee joogipunktides ja finišis.
course_highlights: 8,4 km jooks kulgeb mööda kergliiklusteid, tähistatud ja suunajatega
Maraton koosneb 5 ringist, iga ring on 8,44 km pikkune asfaltkattega kergliiklustee
Teatemaraton koosneb 5 etapist, iga etapp on 8,44 km pikkune ring
additional: Maratonil ja teatemaratonil on osalejate piirangud vastavalt 100 maratoonarit ja 150 tiimi. Jooksul on osalejate piir 150 jooksjat. Stardinumbrite väljastamine toimub võistluspäeval Rocca al Mare kooli juures. Meditsiiniabi on stardi-finišipaigas. Autasustamine toimub peale jooksu või maratoni vastavalt. Rajal jooksmine autoteel on keelatud ja võib kaasa tuua diskvalifitseerimise. Rada asub linnamaastikul, registreerimine ja osavõtutasud on detailselt kirja pandud, üritus toimub iga-aastaselt ning on osa Eesti jooksukalendrist.

name: Varėnos Kalėdinis pusmaratonis
description: On December 20, 2025, Varėna Sports Center is organizing the Christmas running event “Varėna Christmas Half Marathon.” The event is free, but organizers invite participants, if possible, to contribute a donation to improve the quality of the event. Your support helps us create a festive, smooth, and memorable running event for all participants.

name: Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: On the first Saturday of winter, the annual Eurovaistinė Christmas Run will take place—a running celebration that has been held for 50 years and welcomes thousands of participants. The run stands out not only for its festive atmosphere but also for its distinctive participants, dressed in Christmas costumes. This year, the event schedule has shifted so participants can run after dark, when the sparkling Christmas spirit comes alive on the streets of Vilnius!

images.alt_text: Žmonės kalėdiniuose kostiumuose bėgimo renginyje. Šventinė nuotaika.
Kalėdinis bėgimas su Santa Claus kostiumais.
Kalėdinis bėgimas Vilniuje. Bėgikai su Kalėdų Senelio kostiumais bėga gatve.
Kalėdų Senelis su maišu ir eglute.
Kalėdinės dekoracijos ir vaikai su kostiumais, atspindintys šventinę nuotaiką.

name: Kauno „Kalėdinis bėgimas - 2026“
description: The Kaunas Christmas Run is a traditional running event held in Kaunas in December. The event is open to runners of all ages and aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and the popularity of running. The race takes place in Panemunė Forest, and the courses are paved and suitable for both recreational and professional runners. After the run, participants are treated to kūčiukai and tea, and can also use the swimming pool.
course_highlights: Course in Panemunė Forest, Kaunas
Paved surface; snow and ice are possible depending on weather conditions
Choose to run 1.7 km, 5 km (one lap) or 10 km (two laps)
additional: Race bibs will be distributed on race day from 10:00 to 11:40. The entry fee must be paid to the account of the Kaunas Running Club. After the run, participants will be treated to kūčiukai and tea. From 14:30 to 15:30, participants can swim at Žalgiris Swimming Pool (Karaliaus Mindaugo Ave. 50, Kaunas). Registration is permitted only in your own name; bib transfers are prohibited. Registration is open until October 31. Participants will receive personalized bibs. Event date: 2026-12-19

name: Panevėžio Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: On the first Saturday of winter, the annual Eurovaistinė Christmas Run will take place, celebrating its 50th anniversary this year. This running festival will welcome thousands of participants, standing out for its festive atmosphere and distinctive participants dressed in Christmas costumes. The event schedule has been shifted so participants can run after dark, when the magical Christmas spirit comes alive on the streets of Panevėžys. This year, we invite you not only to prepare Christmas costumes but also to add illuminated details that will turn the crowd of runners into a glowing Christmas spectacle.

name: Bėgimas į Naujus
description: Run Into the New Year is an annual race held on the last day of the year. The event brings together runners and enthusiasts who want to celebrate the arrival of the New Year actively. Participants can choose from different distances, allowing everyone to find a challenge that suits them. The route offers beautiful city sights and a unique atmosphere created by participants and spectators.

images.alt_text: Didelis fejerverkas virš miesto, švenčiant Naujuosius metus.
Kalėdų eglutė su šventinėmis lemputėmis ir dekoracijomis, puikiai tinkanti Naujųjų metų šventei.

name: Buugin Pamaus Juoksu
description: Welcome to the first-ever feel-good New Year’s run at Buugi Sports Centre on 31 December 2024 at 18:00! The event is organised jointly by Buugi Sports Centre and Hippoksen Marathon Club, with the aim of offering the best way in Central Finland to start celebrating the New Year in good company with a run and a buffet meal. Participants can choose the 10 km distance, with competitive and recreational categories for women and men.

images.alt_text: Juoksija punaisella juoksuradalla. Hyvän mielen uuden vuoden juoksu.

name: Uudenvuodenjuoksu
location: Tanelinrannan nuoriso- ja urheilukeskus, Lampitie 10, Seinäjoki
distance_verbose: 10 km, 10 km, 8.2 km, 7.6 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2.4 km, 1.2 km
description: The New Year’s Run is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy exercise on New Year’s Eve. The event takes place on 31 December 2024 at various locations, including Seinäjoki, Liminka, Lieto and Imatra, and offers participants a range of distances for runners of different ages and abilities. The courses are officially measured and safe, with traffic marshals. The event brings together running enthusiasts and also offers the chance to enjoy coffee and refreshments from kiosks in the area.

name: Sylvesterloppet Kalmar
description: The Sylvester Race in Kalmar is a local running classic organised by Högby IF Friidrott and held on 31 December 2026. Basic information about the race is available on the club’s website. Officials and volunteers register through the club’s login system.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances around Fredriksskans and Lindöfjärden
A medal and a specially designed hat for everyone who registers
A 5 km untimed walking category, as well as various age-group categories
additional: The Kalmar Sylvester Race is described as a running classic. Officials and volunteers register via the website’s registration form (WordPress), which requires a login: https://friidrott.hogbyif.se/wp-login.php?action=register Start times for the different categories include P/F 5–13, 0.4–2.0 km; M/K 5 and 10 km; and the untimed 5 km walking category. Late registration and payment options include card, Swish or bankgiro.

name: Pažadų Bėgimas
description: PROMISE RUN. We continue the tradition started in 2018. On the morning of 2026-01-01, while the sound of fireworks still echoes in your ears, confirm to yourself during the run that your New Year’s resolutions will really come true. No competition, registration, medals or prizes—just you and your New Year’s “PROMISES.” Run 10 km and write down your goals so you can check on 2027-01-01 whether they came true. The start will take place on 2026-01-01 at 14:00 at Kaunas Santaka Stadium.

images.alt_text: Bėgimas per miestą Naujųjų metų proga, daug bėgikų.

name: Naujametinis ruonių maratonas
description: 2026-01-01 Pasvaliečiai invites all club members and friends to the 1st New Year’s SEALS MARATHON, which will take place in Pasvalys. This marathon is part of the traditional 18th ice-swimming event organized in Pasvalys District. After the marathon, a club members’ meeting will be held, during which the club’s most active members will be awarded.

name: XIV Jonavos Naujametinis bėgimas
location: Žemaitės ir P. Vaičiūno gatvių sankryža, Jonava, Lithuania
description: The 14th traditional Jonava New Year’s Run will take place on January 1, 2027. The start is at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets. The traditional 20 km course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala, and the finish is on Kauno Street near the treatment facilities. The event features a hilly course and winter conditions. After the run, participants are invited to enjoy tea and snacks and collect commemorative medals.
course_highlights: Traditional 20 km running course
Start at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets
The course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala, with the finish on Kauno Street
additional: After the run, participants receive trophies and prizes, commemorative medals, and can enjoy tea and snacks. The course is hilly, and in winter it may be slippery and windy. The course runs through the villages of Čičinai and Kurmagala; the weather is often wintry, and the event is popular with local runners as a way to start the new year.

name: Resolution Run
description: Resolution Run 2026 is a fast, flat 5K taking place on New Year’s Day, January 1, 2026, at 10:15 a.m. in Galway city centre. The route passes through the city centre, starting at the Claddagh, crossing Wolfe Tone Bridge, and continuing along Merchants Road and through the Docks before returning via Grattan Road and the Prom, with a fast finish in South Park, beside Nimmo’s Pier. The route passes many of the city’s most iconic attractions. The race is AAI-certified.

name: Resolution Run 2026
description: Resolution Run 2027 invites you to start the new year with energy and activity. It’s a great opportunity to keep your New Year’s resolutions by running alongside a crowd of enthusiastic runners. The event promises good spirits, smiles, and a fun start to the year in Kaunas.
course_highlights: Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Warm-up for participants in all distances
Run on routes through Kaunas
additional: Distribution of participants’ race packs and awards are scheduled in the event programme. The event will include an official opening and a warm-up for participants in all distances. The event takes place in Kaunas and is organised by VšĮ Kauno maratono klubas. Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km; the event takes place in Kaunas; the organiser offers a festive start and a sense of community.

name: LBT Kėdainiai
location: Kėdainių miesto centrinis stadionas (J. Basanavičiaus g. 1.)
description: Kėdainiai Sports Centre is organizing LBT 1 – the New Year’s Run “KĖDAINIAI 2025,” which will take place on January 5 at 12:00 at the Kėdainiai Central Stadium grounds (J. Basanavičiaus St. 1). The running distances include a 400 m children’s run and 4 km and 8.5 km courses.

images.alt_text: Naujametinis bėgimas "Kėdainiai 2025" plakatas su informacija apie datą, vietą ir distancijas.
Bėgimo lenktynės Kėdainiuose, startas. Sportininkai bėga stadione.
Kėdainių miesto centrinis stadionas, kur vyks bėgimo varžybos.

name: Talvijuoksu Lappeenranta
description: Talvijuoksusarja is a winter running event held in Lappeenranta. The event starts and finishes beside Pallo Sports Hall at Tukkikatu 2. Registration takes place at the starting point 20 minutes before the start. Distances offered are 3 km, 5 km, and 7 km. Children can run an approximately 1 km distance. All routes are out-and-back courses along a lit cycle path. The event is free and open to everyone. The temperature limit is -15 C.

name: Talvijuoksusarja 3/6
description: The 3rd event in the Winter Running Series will take place on 30.12.2023 in Mikkeli, offering runners the opportunity to participate in different distances, including 10 km and 6 km. The event is designed especially for winter conditions and attracts both competitive and recreational runners. Previous races have seen excellent performances, and participants can enjoy the winter running atmosphere.

images.alt_text: KOMIA Talvijuoksusarjan 3/6 osakilpailu Mikkelissä. Juoksijat maantiellä.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run has been promoting the city’s fitness for 30 years. Each month, 100–200 runners of different ages take part. The beautiful route runs through the scenery along the Loimijoki River, with a choice of distances: 5.8 km or 11.2 km. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of the over-100-year-old Elävien kuvien cinema.

name: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti
description: The XXV Run Commemorating Freedom Defenders’ Day in Klaipėda is a traditional running event held to honour those who died and fought for Lithuania’s freedom. The event brings together the city’s community and visitors and takes place in Klaipėda on January 18. Participants can choose between two distances: the main 8 km course and a shorter 3 km course for schoolchildren, seniors and anyone who finds the longer course too challenging. The event starts in the evening, and the routes pass through scenic parts of the city, including a cycle path and the Summer Amphitheatre.
course_highlights: The 8 km course follows a cycle path past Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre, Liepojos Street and H. Manto Street
Finish near Klaipėda City Municipality (Liepų St. 11)
The 3 km course starts near Klaipėda Summer Amphitheatre and is intended for schoolchildren and seniors
additional: Race bibs have an external timing chip. Picking up race bibs in advance is recommended to avoid queues on event day. Bib pickup for 8 km runners is on a bus near the Rotušė, and for 3 km runners it is near the Summer Amphitheatre. Buses depart for the start locations at 19:00. Individual warm-up: 19:45–19:55. The course closes at 21:20. Medals are awarded to the first 900 finishers. The event is organised with buses and community participation; the start is at the Klaipėda Giruliai Radio and TV Tower.

name: Teivocup III 2027
description: Teivocup III 2027 is a six-part training competition and test-run series held once a month from November to April. The event offers running opportunities for different age and competition categories, with distances of 5 km and 2 km. The course follows a pedestrian and cycling path, with the start and finish at the intersection by Teivo Trotting Centre. Registration takes place at Lamminpää Outdoor Centre, and the race starts at 12:00. The best runners are awarded.
course_highlights: The course follows a pedestrian and cycling path
Start and finish at the intersection by Teivo Trotting Centre
Distances of 5 km and 2 km for different categories
additional: Register at Lamminpää Outdoor Centre by 11:30; arriving early is recommended to avoid queues. Categories: 5 km M/M40/M50/N/N40/N50; 2 km P/T 09/11/13. The best runners are awarded. A six-part running series; registration opens at 11:30 and the race starts at 12:00.

name: Aplink Želvos ežerą
description: The “Around Lake Želva” run will take place on January 11, 2025, in Suginčiai (Molėtai District), in remembrance of Lithuania’s Freedom Defenders Day. The event aims to promote running in Lithuania, improve athletic performance, and encourage a healthy, active lifestyle. We recommend arriving at around 10:00; the race starts at 11:00.

name: Gdynia ULTRA WAY - Winter Race Stary Wilk
Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė is a Backyard Ultra-style race designed to make it easier for runners to cover 100 miles. If you’ve never experienced a DNF in your life, here you’ll have the chance to earn one with honor. There will be only one winner.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter is a winter adventure for runners who love nature even when the temperature drops. The race takes place in beautiful Norra Djurgården, starting and finishing at Stora Skuggan. Choose from three distances on snowy trails and enjoy a unique winter medal at the finish. After the race, warm up at the after-run with a hot drink and refreshments alongside other runners.
course_highlights: Rolling snowy trails in Norra Djurgården
Aid stations at 4 km on the 6 km and 12 km courses
Start and finish at Stora Skuggan, easily accessible by metro and bus
additional: Everyone who finishes receives a unique winter medal. Aid stations are located at 4 km on the 6 km and 12 km courses. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggan, close to the metro and bus. After the race, a warming after-run with a hot drink and refreshments is available. Registration is through the partner EQ Timing and is binding, with no refunds. Refund protection can be purchased as an add-on through Startklar. Start and finish at Stora Skuggan. Registration is open until 29 January 2027.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://stockholm.ecotrail.com/sv/lopp-ecotrail-stockholm/ecotrail-stockholm-winter): 2027-01-30 — "Den 30 januari 2027 går den andra upplagan av vårt upplevelserika vinterlopp!" (was estimated 2027-01-30)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Den 30 januari 2027 går den andra upplagan av vårt upplevelserika vinterlopp!

name: Winter Run (Stockholm)
organizer: Marathongruppen med Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn och ungdomar har ett pris hela perioden fram till evenemanget.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn och ungdomar har ett pris hela perioden fram till evenemanget.

description: Winter Run Stockholm is an atmospheric winter race taking place at Skansen and Djurgården on January 31, 2027. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a course that combines historic surroundings with beautiful winter scenery, illuminated by fire performers, torches and flares. The race also includes a children’s race for ages 7–11, making it an experience for the whole family. The event is organized by Marathongruppen together with the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and any surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 57% paved surface and 43% gravel
Just over 1 km through Skansen’s historic surroundings, with the rest around Djurgården
The course is illuminated by flares, fire baskets and a fire show
additional: Children’s race: 1.3 km for ages 7–11. Minimum age: 13 for 5 km (11 when accompanied by a parent or guardian) and 15 for 10 km (13 when accompanied by a parent or guardian). Skansen is a dog-free zone. The course is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and officially measured by an approved course measurer. There is a risk of ice on the course, so shoes suitable for winter conditions are recommended. Skansen opens to runners at 14:30. Start times: children’s race 16:30, 5 km 17:00, 10 km 18:00. There is also a children’s race for ages 7–11. Any surplus goes back to sport.

pipeline_log.message:
New race date found on official site (https://winterrun.com/): 2027-01-31 — "H3: Stockholm
Content: Lørdag 31. januar" (was estimated 2027-01-30)

name: VI Utenos sporto arenos maratonas
description: The Utena Arena Marathon is a unique indoor marathon held in the city of Utena. Participants run 182.5 laps of 231.3 metres, offering a distinctive opportunity to experience a marathon in a controlled environment. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs looking to test their endurance and speed. It is a traditional annual event that promotes sportsmanship and community spirit.
course_highlights: Indoor venue – the race takes place inside the arena
182.5 laps of 231.3 metres
A controlled environment unaffected by weather conditions
additional: Registration takes place only on the event day at the start venue; advance registration is not available. The event will take place in Utena, Lithuania, on February 7, 2027; the event description highlights community spirit and a variety of running events.

name: Teivocup IV 2027
description: Teivocup IV 2027 is a six-part series of training races and test runs held once a month from November to April. The event’s fourth race takes place on February 6 at Lamminpää Outdoor Recreation Lodge in Ylöjärvi. The series offers several distances for different age groups and divisions, and the route follows a pedestrian and cycle path near the Teivo Race Centre junction. Registration is on site by 11:30, and the start is at 12:00. The top runners will be awarded prizes.
course_highlights: The route follows a pedestrian and cycle path
Start and finish at the Teivo Race Centre junction
Several distances for different age groups and divisions (5 km and 2 km)
additional: Registration is on site at Lamminpää Outdoor Recreation Lodge by 11:30. The distances are 5 km (M/M40/M50/N/N40/N50) and 2 km (P/T 09/11/13). With several competition classes, the event offers an opportunity to take part in winter running in Finnish nature.

name: Vintermossa (Mossaloppet)
description: Vintermossa is a winter edition of Mossarun, a trail race featuring a challenging, technical 21 km loop with over 600 metres of elevation gain. The race is self-supported and unstaffed, so participants navigate using a GPX file, with no trail markings. A large fire is kept burning throughout the event to warm up cold runners, and participants can grill their own food. Skis are allowed if there is enough snow, making it possible to combine running and skiing on the loop.
course_highlights: 21 km loop with 600+ metres of elevation gain
Technical, hilly terrain with high-quality trails
Unstaffed race with self-navigation using a GPX file
additional: The race is unsupported, with no timing or checkpoints. There is no cut-off time. Mandatory equipment includes an emergency blanket and a headlamp. A large fire is kept burning throughout the event for participants to warm themselves between laps. Participants can choose to run one or more laps. Skis are allowed when there is snow. Participants are encouraged to Swish any amount they wish to War Child or another organisation of their choice. An external race calendar lists the distance as 241.4 km; this information is not confirmed on Mossarun’s results page.

name: Sormlands Winter Trail
location: Nävekvarns IP, Nävekvarn, Nyköping Municipality, Sweden
description: Sörmlands Winter Trail is a winter race offering three distances: 43 km, 22 km and 10 km, all starting and finishing at Nävekvarns IP in Nävekvarn. The routes pass through varied terrain, including forest trails, hilly landscapes and scenic coastal sections, providing a challenging and picturesque experience. The race uses electronic timing and has several aid stations with food and drinks along the course. After the finish, all participants are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic recovery beer. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment and access to showers and changing rooms at the start.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest trails, hilly slopes and coastal paths
Several aid stations with food, hot drinks and Umara Energy
Electronic chip timing and clear cut-off times for each distance
additional: Start times: 43 km at 09:00, 22 km at 10:00, 10 km at 11:00. Maximum cut-off times: 8 hours for 43 km, 5 hours for 22 km, 2 hours for 10 km. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a mobile phone, windproof jacket, thermal base layer, hat, gloves, water bottle (at least 500 ml), whistle, emergency blanket and headlamp when running in the dark. Showers, changing rooms and toilets are available at Nävekvarns IP. Parking is available for a fee at the start/finish area. After the race, runners are served a hot meal and non-alcoholic Mineral Brewing Recovery Lager. The distances are 10, 22 and 43 km. Race numbers can be collected at the start area at Nävekvarns IP. Aid stations offer food and hot drinks, and a hot meal is served at the finish. Mandatory equipment includes, among other things, a charged phone, wind jacket, water and trail shoes with good grip. Parking is available for a small fee.

name: 15-asis bėgimas „Žiema Jonavoje“
description: The 15th “Winter in Jonava” run invites runners to a traditional winter event in the surroundings of Jonava. The event takes place on cycling paths around the Jonava ponds, offering an opportunity to enjoy winter scenery and active leisure. It is a great chance for both experienced and beginner runners to test their endurance and enjoy a community atmosphere. The event takes place in February, when winter is still fully present in nature.
course_highlights: Run around the Jonava ponds
The route follows cycling paths
Winter scenery and fresh air
additional: The event attracts participants from various cities across Lithuania, and is open to all age groups. The 2024 event had 88 participants, and the scenic routes are suitable for runners of various levels.

name: Bieg Urodzinowy z Portem Gdynia Bieg 1926
Bieg Walentynkowy Run in Sopot II
Trailo kalvės S4E4. Prienai

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alavinė jaunimo kategorijos 3,15 € + 0,08 € bilieto paslaugos mokestis

description: Trailo Kalvė S4E4 Prienai is a winter trail running event held at the Giraitiškės recreation area in Prienai. This stage traditionally took place in autumn, but this season participants are invited to take on the course in winter. The event offers routes of various lengths for runners of different ages and experience levels, from children to adults. It is part of the Trailo Kalvė Cup, which features routes of varying difficulty and elevation gain.
course_highlights: Routes from 5 km to 23 km, with varying elevation gain
The winter season offers a unique opportunity to run on snow-covered forest trails
Start at the Giraitiškės recreation area, Prienai
additional: There are no medals, but participants registering for the first time this season receive a Trailo Kalvė running band. The event takes place in winter, so the routes are snow-covered and require special preparation. Registration is available only for team participants; regular tickets are recommended for individual entries. Participants are encouraged to register in teams.
