name: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“
description: The 63rd traditional “Anykščiai - Puntukas Stone - Anykščiai” race invites participants to spend May 7 actively amid the beautiful landscapes of the Anykščiai region. The race distances and difficulty levels are suited to participants of different ages and fitness levels, from a fun run for children to an 11 km challenge for endurance runners. The event is the oldest in Lithuania and is renowned for its tradition and friendly atmosphere, attracting sports enthusiasts from across the country. Participants will receive commemorative medals, while the fastest runners in the 11 km distance will win cash prizes.
course_highlights: A scenic route through the Anykščiai landscape, winding through the Anykščiai Forest celebrated in the poetry of Antanas Baranauskas
Distances for all abilities: from 300 m for children to 11 km for endurance runners
Start near the Angels Museum in Anykščiai
additional: Starts by age group: 10:30 — children’s fun run “Puntukėlis”; 11:30 — 3 km distance; 11:50 — race opening ceremony; 12:00 — 6 km and 11 km distances. Registration is open only until April 28 at 12:00; registration will not be available on race day. Participants who finish will receive commemorative medals. The fastest runners in the 11 km distance will receive cash prizes. Participants are offered advance registration, the opportunity to recover after the race in a swimming pool and sauna complex, prizes and discounts, and various age groups.

name: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas
description: Klaipėda EKOMarathon is a traditional running event held on the forest trails of Giruliai in Klaipėda. Both amateur and professional runners can take part, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. Distances range from 2 km for schoolchildren to 42.2 km for Ekomarathon participants, who run 10 laps of 4.2 km each. The event is organized by the Klaipėda city running club “Maratonas” and supported by Klaipėda City Municipality.
course_highlights: Ekomarathon course: 10 laps of 4.2 km on the forest trails of Giruliai
Schoolchildren’s course: 2 km (1 km out, 1 km back)
Start in Giruliai Forest, at the beginning of the bike path beyond the Summer Stage
additional: On race day, the timing system operates until 15:00. The entry fee is paid on site when collecting the race number. The first 300 participants receive commemorative medals; all participants receive certificates. Participants must bring an identity document to collect their race number. Participants agree that event organizers may use photographs and video footage taken during the event for marketing purposes. 4.2 km and 42.2 km distances, 2 km schoolchildren’s race, start in Giruliai Forest, online registration until April 30.

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: Winter Bay Backyard Ultra in Trosa is a unique ultramarathon where participants run laps on a 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River. Each lap must be completed within an hour to continue, and the race goes on until only one runner remains. The course is easy and flat, making it suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and enthusiasts. Sports drinks, fruit, sandwiches and food are provided during the race. There is also a team competition and a children’s race, Mini-TUB. The race is celebrating its 10th anniversary with extra-special medals and prizes for the top three in the men’s and women’s categories.
course_highlights: 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River
Easy, flat course suited to ultrarunning
Mini-TUB children’s race with its own course and medals
additional: Each participant in the main race receives a free silicone cup from Umara when collecting their race number. Umara sports drinks, fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen and food from Trosa Stadshotell are served during the race. Sandwiches and sweets are offered at each lap. There is a team competition in which the three best results from each club are counted, with prize money for the winning team. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 and is open to children born in 2017 or later. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with race officials. The race is fully booked. There is a team competition and a Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later. Tent space can be arranged in consultation with race officials; a limited number of motorhome spaces are available, but there is no electricity. Caravans are not accepted.

name: Sevede Trail Run
location: Mariannelund, Eksjö Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: Sevede Trail Run is organized by Hässleby Ski and Orienteering Club in Mariannelund and offers a challenging, scenic trail run. The race attracts runners of all ages and levels and takes place in beautiful woodland with varied terrain. It is a much-loved tradition that brings together participants and spectators for a wonderful day outdoors.
course_highlights: Trail running in woodland
Varied terrain with trails and forest roads
Scenic views around Mariannelund

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a unique ultrarun held in central Trosa on an easy, flat 6.7 km course, mostly along the Trosa River. The aim is to complete as many laps as possible, with one hour allowed per lap. Participants can start again every hour if they have completed the lap. It is a festive, social race with prize money, a team competition and prize draws during the event. Children can take part in Mini-TUB, with its own course and attractive medals. Sports drink, fruit, sandwiches and food from local sponsors are served during the race.
course_highlights: 6.7 km course in central Trosa, mostly along the Trosa River
Easy, flat course suited to completing multiple laps
700 m Mini-TUB children’s course that follows the main course
additional: Start time: 10:00 on 1 May 2027. Mini-TUB for children starts at 14:15 the same day. Umara sports drink and fruit from ICA Kvantum Trossen are served during the race. Participants receive a free Umara silicone cup at bib collection. Food from Trosa Stadshotell, sandwiches and sweets are provided at each lap checkpoint. In the team competition, the three best results from each club count. Tents may be set up outside the start area in consultation with race officials. No plastic cups are used, for environmental reasons. The 2027 race starts on 1 May at 10:00 and is sold out. The team competition counts the three best results per club. Sports drink, fruit, sandwiches, sweets and food are served during the race. Mini-TUB for children born in 2017 or later starts at 14:15.

name: Vilnius trail run 2026
distance_verbose: 100 km, 100 km, 73 km, 70 km, Maratonas, Pusmaratonas, Pusmaratonas, 15 km, 5 km, 1.8 km
description: Vilnius Trail Run 2027 invites runners to experience a unique variety of courses in Vilnius’s natural surroundings and urban environment. The event offers routes ranging from 15+ km for beginners to a challenging 108 km course around Vilnius. Participants can enjoy varied terrain, including forest trails, mountain roads, and scenic viewpoints offering unforgettable views of the Lithuanian landscape. It is a great opportunity to test your endurance and discover the city’s nature and culture while running.
course_highlights: Unique routes in Vilnius from 15+ km to 108 km
Varied terrain: forest trails and mountain roads
Scenic viewpoints with views of the Lithuanian landscape
additional: The event takes place at Kalnų Park Stadium, T. Kosciuškos g. 5, Vilnius. The number of participants exceeds 1,000. Organizer: VšĮ, address: Balžio g. 21C-5, Vilnius, telephone: +370 610 24484. The event offers courses featuring forest trails, mountain tracks, and scenic viewpoints; participants can choose from various distances and age groups, including an ultramarathon and children’s races.

name: Vilniaus pavasario maratonas
description: The Vilnius Spring Marathon invites runners of all levels to test their strength in the springtime atmosphere of Vilnius’s Vingis Park. The event offers a range of distances, from a 600 m children’s race to the classic 42.195 km marathon, as well as a half marathon and shorter races. It’s a great opportunity to kick off the running season surrounded by nature, moving through the city and its parks while enjoying the renewal of spring. The event is organized with great attention to all participants’ experience and promotes an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Vingis Park amphitheatre
Run through Vilnius city parks and streets
Distances from a 600 m children’s race to the 42.195 km marathon
additional: The event takes place on 2026-05-02, with the start at 10:00 at the Vingis Park amphitheatre. Distances: 42.195 km, 21.098 km, 10.6 km, 5.3 km, and 600 m for children. The regulations are available at https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis/nuostatai/. Registration is available at https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis. The event offers various distances, including races for children and young people, as well as the option to participate with insurance. Registration is through myrace.lt.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a popular running event that welcomes competitive runners, recreational runners and families to run through beautiful Swedish countryside along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg. The event offers several distances, including a half marathon, a 10 km race and a 5 km recreational race. It is marked by a strong sense of community and scenic views along the canal. Kanallöpet is organised by Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna, and is a tradition that returns every spring.
course_highlights: Run along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Half marathon, 10 km and 5 km recreational races
Beautiful Swedish countryside and scenic views
additional: The event has competitive and recreational categories, as well as family-friendly distances. The organising clubs are Borensbergs IF, Vreta SoMK and OK Skogsströvarna. Participants receive medals, although medal deliveries may sometimes be delayed. For the 2025 race, buses are reported to be arranged from Borensberg to the starting locations. Competitive categories require membership in a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation.

name: SäterMaran (inkl. DM i halvmaraton)
description: SäterMaran is a running event organized by Säters IF FIK, offering half-marathon and 10 km distances. The full marathon has been held in the past but is currently closed to late entries due to low participation. The event is a welcome opportunity for runners of different levels to challenge themselves in a beautiful setting in Säter. Säters IF FIK is an active athletics club with dedicated leaders and a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 10 km distances are offered
The event takes place in Säter, surrounded by scenic landscapes
Organized by Säters IF FIK, a club with a long tradition in athletics
additional: Late entry for the full marathon is closed due to low participation. Registration for the half-marathon and 10 km remains open as usual. The organizer publishes the invitation, course route, race information, schedule, start list, and results on the club's website.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a fun fitness event for women held at Studenternas IP in Uppsala. Participants can choose to run or walk 2.5 km or 5 km on a certified course. The event is all about the joy of exercise and togetherness, with a fantastic atmosphere and entertainment along the course and in the event area. After the finish, teams that have registered five people are treated to a picnic, making it a social and enjoyable spring evening together.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP
Entertainment and encouragement along the course and in the event area
additional: Bib collection takes place May 3–5 at Intersport Boländerna. A picnic is provided after the finish for teams of five. The event area opens at 17:30, with a sponsor village and activities. Participants are advised to arrive changed; changing facilities and showers are available. Water stations and toilets are available at the start and finish. Parking is available south of the arena, but environmentally friendly travel is encouraged. According to the local race information, registration can be completed online until race day, no later than one hour before the first start. Timing for the 5 km can be opted out of. Teams of five participants are treated to a picnic after the finish.

description: Bankvarvet is a popular fun run in Kullaparken, Kisa, focusing on the joy of being active rather than the fastest time or lap. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and a 900-metre Minivarvet for children born in 2016 or later. It’s a community celebration with entertainment, activities, and food, perfect for families, groups of friends, and companies looking to build team spirit. Bankvarvet attracts many participants and is known for its warm and welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Kullaparken in Kisa
A 900-metre Minivarvet for children
5 km and 10 km routes for adults and young people
additional: Kullaparken opens at 16:00, with activities including basketball, football, table tennis, and boules, as well as food and drink. Bankvarvet is a popular company activity for building team spirit. The event runs from 16:00 to 20:00, with the 5 km and 10 km races starting at 18:30. The official information currently available describes the 2026 edition: the race starts at 18:30, and activities in Kullaparken begin at 16:00. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed.

name: Valio Helsinki City Run
description: Valio Helsinki City Run is Finland’s largest running event, bringing more than 24,000 runners from over 110 countries to Helsinki Olympic Stadium and the city streets. The event offers six different running distances, including a marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 5 km run and walk, and the children’s Minimarathon. The routes are scenic and coastal, and the finish is at Olympic Stadium. The event also offers a wide range of services, such as world-class timekeeping, refreshment stations, and free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run.
course_highlights: Scenic coastal routes in Helsinki
Finish and event centre at Olympic Stadium
Officially measured, AIMS-certified routes
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Olympic Stadium before the race. Payment with sports benefits is available (ePassi, Edenred, Zevoy Benefits). Group registration requires at least 5 runners. Groups of at least 10 people receive free event shirts. Free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run. Refreshment stations and gels along the route. Cancellation insurance is available for purchase. Free group training sessions and training plans. World-class timekeeping (excluding the walk). The event includes several distances, such as the marathon, half marathon, 5 km run, and walking events. Participants can follow live results and get their certificates as soon as they finish. The event takes place at Olympic Stadium and also includes an event week with activities and sponsorship opportunities.

name: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton
description: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton on Tartumaa Tervisespordikeskuses toimuva jooksuvõistluse traditsiooniline sündmus, mis pakub osalejatele võimalust nautida maastikujooksu kaunist looduses. Üritus on osa Eesti liikumisharrastuse edendamise programmist ning sobib erineva tasemega jooksjatele, kes soovivad parandada oma füüsilist vormi ja vaimset heaolu. Maraton rõhutab liikumise tähtsust tervise ja hea enesetunde säilitamisel ning kutsub kõiki aktiivseid inimesi osalema. Korraldajaks on Liikumisharrastuse Kompetentsikeskus, kes toetab Eesti tervislikuma ja aktiivsema ühiskonna kujundamist.
course_highlights: Maastikujooks Tartumaa Tervisespordikeskuse kaunites metsamaastikes
Mitmekesine ja vaheldusrikas rada sobib erineva tasemega jooksjatele
Võimalus nautida loodust ja parandada vaimset ning füüsilist tervist
additional: Üritus toimub Tartumaa Tervisespordikeskuses ning pakub osalejatele registreerimisvõimalust ja stardinumbreid Tartus Turu 10 ning Aura keskuse parklas.

name: RAHOLAN KYMPPI (TAMPERE)
location: Tampereen Tesoman jäähallin parkkipaikka, Tampere, Pirkanmaa, Finland
description: Raholan Kymppi is an annual 10-kilometre running event starting from the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere. It gives runners the chance to enjoy a course that is traditional and popular with locals. The event is part of the running calendar organised by Team Rahola and attracts a diverse range of participants. It is a good opportunity to test your fitness in spring and experience the sense of community at a running event.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometre course
Start and finish at the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere
A traditional local running event popular with the community
additional: Team Rahola's Monday group runs from Tesoma Ice Hall at 18:00 offer an opportunity to train. No specific start times or prices are listed for the running event. Team Rahola also offers other running events and training sessions, such as the Cooper test and weekly events. The event takes place at the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere, and participants can run or walk. The event offers a chance to enjoy exercise in surroundings that combine nature and the city.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
description: Kolmårdstrailen is one of Sweden’s finest trail races, offering challenging, hilly courses in the scenic Kolmården terrain. Runners can choose between distances of 21 km, 11 km and 6 km, as well as a 500-metre children’s course for the youngest participants. The courses run through forests, over rocky outcrops and along hiking trails, with beautiful views and sections of technical terrain. The focus is on the experience, with a course that combines the beauty of nature with a physical challenge.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with rocky-outcrop running and forest trails
Passage through Rödgölen Nature Reserve, with soft singletrack
Views from Kolmården’s highest peak, 171 metres above sea level
additional: Race bib collection and late registration take place on race day between 9.00 and 11.00. Payment is by cash or Swish. All courses pass the race centre approximately 1 km before the finish, where the final kilometre is tough and partly off-trail through the forest. There are water stations along the course, including one at 7.5 km by the Scout Hut at Gransjön. Volunteers are needed for race bib collection, serving and water stations.

name: Hoby backyard Ultra 12H
description: The first edition of Hoby Backyard Ultra 12h! The course is 6,706 m, with approximately 50% trail/gravel road and 50% asphalt. 57 meters of elevation gain per lap.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
description: Öland Church Relay is a classic long-distance relay, being held for the 47th time, offering a fantastic running experience on Öland as spring gets underway. The start and finish are in Färjestaden. The race comes in two formats: a longer course with eleven legs totaling 67.5 km and a shorter course with six legs totaling 23.5 km. The race welcomes both dedicated runners and beginners, with legs for all levels. Organizers Högby IF and Öland Sports Association aim to provide the best possible service, with course marshals, a race announcer and individual timing.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/olands-kyrkstafett/): 2027-05-08 — "Tid & datum 08 maj 2027 kl. 10:00" (was estimated 2027-04-08)

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a wonderful spring race that runs along the beautiful Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred. The race offers a fantastic nature experience and a great atmosphere, making it perfect for both beginners and experienced runners. It is a welcoming event that invites participants to enjoy exercise and camaraderie in a scenic setting.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://visithultsfred.se/evenemang/strandmilen/): 2027-05-08 — "Strandmilen — 8 maj, 2027 kl.10:00 - 13:00" (was estimated 2027-04-08)

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby City Run is a family-friendly fun run starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Mjölby. The main race is six kilometres through the city. There is also KyrkRundan, approximately three kilometres long, and a free children’s race. The event features music and activities along the course and is a local community celebration that welcomes walkers, joggers and runners alike. You are warmly welcome to a day of movement, togetherness and joy on Saturday, 9 May 2026.

name: SHE Silverlöpet
organizer: Sala-Heby Energi AB (i samarbete med IFK Sala)
description: SHE Silverlöpet is an annual running race in Sala, organised by IFK Sala. The race brings together runners of different ages and ability levels and is part of the club’s wide-ranging sports activities. Results from previous years are available, and the race is a popular event in the region. Registration is available through external platforms, and IFK Sala can be contacted for more information.

name: Spångaloppet
description: Spångaloppet is a local running race organised by Spånga/Bromstens Bandyklubb, returning on 9 May 2026. The event offers routes for different ages and abilities, with 10 km and 5 km courses through beautiful natural areas and past Spånga town centre, as well as a 2 km course for younger participants and a 400 m children’s race. The start and finish for all races are at Spånga IP. Everyone is welcome to take part, and registration is via RaceID under Spångaloppet 2026.

name: Sommarro Snabbare
description: Sommarro Snabbare is a unique, fast-paced running race in the Sommarro cultural reserve in Örebro. The race takes place on a 2.6 km loop through a forest park, with each lap having to be completed in progressively less time (the first lap in 25 minutes, the next in 24 minutes, the third in 23 minutes, and so on), making the race faster with every round. Everyone starts on equal terms, and the winner is the one who lasts the longest—making it suitable for both fast runners and those looking to challenge their endurance. There is also Lilla Sommarro Snabbare for children born in 2013 or later (one lap, untimed).

name: RASA Druskininkų maratonas
organizer: Asociacija Sporto renginiai ir Druskininkų sporto centras
description: RASA Druskininkų maratonas yra tarptautinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Druskininkuose prie Vijūnėlės ežero. Renginys skatina bėgimą kaip sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir siekia populiarinti lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje bei didinti Druskininkų gyventojų aktyvumą. Varžybose dalyvauti gali visi norintys, o maratono ir pusmaratonio rungtyse startuoti gali tik sulaukę 18 metų. Dalyviai varžosi įvairiose distancijose nuo 500 m iki maratono, o visi apdovanojami specialiais renginio medaliais.

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking w Wilkowie Nowowiejskim to malownicza i wymagająca trasa o długości 8,2 km, będąca pierwszym etapem XIV edycji Grand Prix Nordic Walking. Impreza odbędzie się 9 maja 2026 roku i stanowi doskonałą okazję do sportowej rywalizacji oraz poznania lokalnych atrakcji, takich jak największy chodak czy stół biesiadny. Uczestnicy mogą przygotowywać się korzystając z certyfikowanych tras Nordic Walking dostępnych w gminie Nowa Wieś Lęborska.

name: Red Bull Wings for Life World run
description: Red Bull Wings for Life World Run is a unique race held simultaneously around the world, including in Vingis Park in Vilnius. Participants run as far as they can until they are caught by the Catcher Car. The event supports research into spinal cord injuries, with 100% of the entry fee going to research. Join thousands of runners around the world and run for those who can’t.
course_highlights: The run takes place in Vingis Park, Vilnius
Starts simultaneously with runners around the world
A unique Catcher Car format that ends the run
additional: The start is at 11:00 UTC. Participants run as far as they can until they are caught by the Catcher Car. 100% of the entry fee goes to research into spinal cord injuries. The event takes place simultaneously around the world, including in Vilnius. It takes place in Vingis Park; participants can choose to run or walk; there is no traditional finish line; funds are raised for spinal cord injury research.

name: A.Vietrino taurės bėgimo varžybos
organizer: Lietuvos lengvosios atletikos federacija, Kauno bėgimo mėgėjų klubas, Lietuvos sporto universitetas
description: The A. Vietrinas Cup running race is held in memory of Alfonso Vietrinas, a pioneer of marathon running in Lithuania. The race takes place in Kaunas Oak Grove Park, with the start and finish by the monument to S. Darius and S. Girėnas. Participants can choose between the 2.5 km and 10 km distances. The course is certified and consists of a 2.5 km loop. The event promotes running in Lithuania and welcomes everyone who has a doctor’s approval to participate.
course_highlights: The course runs through Oak Grove Park
The certified course is a 2.5 km loop
Start and finish by the monument to S. Darius and S. Girėnas
additional: The 2.5 km race starts at 11:30, and the 10 km race starts at 12:00. Participants must wear their race number on the front of their shirt. Age-group winners and placing participants, as well as the youngest and oldest participants, receive commemorative cups. The use of vehicles and personal escorts is prohibited during the race. The event aims to encourage physical activity and build a community of running enthusiasts in Lithuania.

name: Tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos „Kresowe Trail“
location: Nemenčinės apylinkės, Nemenčinė, Vilniaus rajonas, Lithuania
organizer: Vilniaus rajono savivaldybė, Vilniaus rajono sporto centras, Vilniaus rajono sporto mokykla, fondas Maratony Kresowe
description: The international “Kresowe Trail” running competition in Nemenčinė offers a unique opportunity to run through the surroundings of the Vilnius District Sports Centre. The competition takes place on June 2, with routes of varying lengths—from the shorter 6 km Szpurt run to the longer 18.6 km Wertep route. The event is suitable for both professional and recreational runners, with electronic timing and a race bib valid for the entire season. Participants can enjoy routes marked with green and red arrows, and awards and hot food await after the run.
course_highlights: Szpurt 6 km run marked with green arrows on a yellow background
Wertep 18.6 km run marked with red arrows
Two refreshment stations on the Wertep route
additional: Registration takes place before the start, from 8:30 to 9:20, no later than 10 minutes before the start. The race office is open on June 1 from 15:00 to 18:00 at the Vilnius District Sports Centre. The course time limit is 2 hours 15 minutes. Electronic timing and a free race bib with a timing chip, valid for the entire season. Hot food is offered to participants after the run. Starting areas are separated by distance: Szpurt 6 km and Wertep 19 km. The event includes refreshment stations, electronic timing, a free race bib, medical coverage, and awards.

name: Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: Wings for Life World Run to wyjątkowy, globalny bieg, który odbywa się jednocześnie na całym świecie. Zamiast tradycyjnej mety, uczestnicy ścigają się z wirtualnym Samochodem Pościgowym, który startuje 30 minut po biegaczach i stopniowo zwiększa prędkość, aż dogoni ostatniego zawodnika. W Gdańsku Południe bieg odbędzie się 10 maja 2026 roku, startując o godzinie 13:00 w okolicy mety Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie. Trasa to pętla około 3 km po utwardzonej nawierzchni, z minimalnym podbiegiem na łączniku. Cały dochód z wpisowego wspiera badania nad rdzeniem kręgowym.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset in Växjö is a popular spring running event offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances around the beautiful Lake Växjö, with the start and finish at Strandbjörket. The event is open to everyone and offers both individual and team registration. Teams consist of five people and receive a shared picnic after finishing. The event has a wonderful spring atmosphere, with a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and prizes for participants. It is a fun run with timing on the 5 km course, but participants can choose to run without timing if they wish. Vårruset is organized by IFK Växjö in collaboration with Marathongruppen and several athletics clubs.
course_highlights: The course goes around Lake Växjö through beautiful natural surroundings
Start and finish at Strandbjörket, near Strandbjörkshallen
A water station and toilets are available at the event area
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in Växjö a few days before the event. Team leaders receive a picnic voucher on their race bib to collect the picnic after the event. The event area opens at 17:00 with a sponsor village, and light refreshments are served. Participants are encouraged to arrive dressed for the race and to travel to the event area in an environmentally friendly way. The race bib must be clearly visible throughout the race. Participants can run, jog or walk. Individual registration includes a medal, finish-line bag, music quiz and race bib; team registration also includes a picnic. Timing is available for the 5 km distance and can be opted out of. Published local information applies to the 2026 event.

description: The festive “Kuršėnams 463” run is a traditional running event held in Kuršėnai, Šiauliai District. The event aims to promote running and encourage a healthy lifestyle, inviting runners of all ages to take part. The races take place by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge, with three distances on offer: approximately 463 m, 2.5 km, and 10 km. Participants can enjoy a symbolic route and a friendly atmosphere, and the event concludes with awards and a joint finish at around 21:30.
course_highlights: A symbolic route of approximately 463 m by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge
A 2.5 km loop that 10 km runners complete four times
The races take place in an urban setting, with a convenient start and finish
additional: Race schedule: 19:30 — 463 m start; 19:40 — 2.5 km start; 20:00 — 10 km start. Awards take place after the last participant finishes, at around 21:30. Participants must be healthy or have a doctor’s clearance to exercise. The health and conduct of underage participants are supervised by accompanying adults. The race takes place by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge; registration and race-number pickup are by the bridge; participant age groups; COVID-19 safety requirements.

name: V Nocny Bieg Parami ze Świetlikami
description: V Nocny Bieg Parami ze Świetlikami to wyjątkowa nocna impreza biegowa odbywająca się w Redzie, przy zbiorniku retencyjnym. Charakterystyczne dla tego biegu są czołówki biegaczy oraz świetlna oprawa trasy, które tworzą spektakularny efekt wizualny. Startują pary, co podkreśla integracyjny charakter wydarzenia i wyróżnia je na tle innych imprez sportowych w województwie pomorskim. Bieg odbywa się po zmroku, co dodaje mu niepowtarzalnej atmosfery i emocji.

price_range: Gratis enligt information om tidigare upplagor

description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Skärholmen, offering races for all ages, from a Mini Race for the youngest participants to a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over. The race is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that works with young people in Sweden’s Million Programme suburbs. There is music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a specially designed medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, uplifting fitness festival that encourages exercise and a sense of community.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over
Lilla Skärholmsloppet: approximately 1.6 km for children from preschool class to Year 6
Mini Skärholmsloppet: 500 metres for children aged 0–6
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Music and DJs along the course. A medal for everyone who completes the race. The entry fee includes a race bib, medal, fruit and drink. Lilla Skärholmsloppet has start times divided by school year, with colour-coded start groups. The Mini Race is 500 metres and can be run together with a parent. Late registration may be available at race-bib collection on 15 May and on race day, subject to availability. The race centre at SKHLM offers race-bib collection and bag storage; late registration may be available subject to availability. The recommended route is the red line 13 metro to Skärholmen. Details for the 2027 edition have not been confirmed in the sources provided.

name: Borgarloppet Trail Race
location: NIK Arena (Näsvikens skidstadion), Näsviken, Hudiksvall Municipality, Sweden
description: Borgarloppet is a scenic trail race along the Borgarleden trail between the Dellen lakes, finishing at NIK Arena in Näsviken. The course features varied terrain, with a long climb at the start, followed by a downhill section, an easier middle section and a challenging finish with technical trails and steep hills. Participants in the 13 km class are bussed to the starting point, and there are several water stations along the course. After the race, kolbulle and a well-stocked coffee table are offered to everyone except the children’s class, which receives cordial, a bun, a banana and a medal at the finish.
course_highlights: The course follows the Borgarleden trail, with beautiful views over the southern part of Lake Dellen
The terrain includes a long climb, downhill running, and technical trails with steep hills
Water stations are located at 6.2 km, 9.9 km, 13.8 km and 18.7 km
additional: Start and finish at NIK Arena (Näsviken ski stadium). The 13 km starting point is at Simabobacken; participants are bussed from the ski stadium to the start. Online registration closes on Thursday evening before race day. After that, on-site registration is available until one hour before the start, with payment by Swish only. Race bibs are collected on site. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women’s and men’s classes, and to everyone in the children’s class. The cutoff is at Borgarberget (19 km) after 3:30 hours. Start and finish at NIK Arena (Näsviken ski stadium). Participants in the 13 km classes are bussed to the start at Simabobacken. In 2026, kolbulle and a coffee table at the finish were included in the entry fee, except for the children’s class.

name: Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka
description: Kilsbergen Out & Back is a unique and friendly trail run in Ånnaboda, near Örebro, where participants choose their own distance by running one, two or all three out-and-back routes. The race offers hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections and beautiful trails. Everyone starts at the same time from the same place, creating a social and relaxed atmosphere throughout the day. After finishing, participants are served a simple hot meal, with a vegetarian option.
course_highlights: Three out-and-back routes of 10 km, 26 km and 54 km
Hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections
The Bergslagsleden Trail, with a turnaround point at the Rusakulan viewpoint
additional: The maximum number of participants is 100. Bibs can be collected from 08:00 at the race centre. The start, finish and race centre are at the warming hut by the artificial snow ski track in Ånnaboda. Toilets are available in the area; changing facilities and showers are at the SM hut by the lower car park. Trail shoes with good grip are recommended. Runners must carry all their own equipment and fuel; there is no support along the course. The race centre will have an aid station with water, sports drink, bananas, sweets, crisps, buns and more. Runners may leave their own drop bags there. Parking is recommended at the lower car park, with signs directing you to the race centre. The organiser’s information lists the start time as 09:00, a maximum of 100 participants and the final registration date as 15 May. Runners are responsible for their own equipment and fuel; support is permitted only at the race centre. Trail shoes with good grip are recommended.

name: Örbyhus half-marathon (10K) - Örbyhus
location: Örbyhus, Tierp Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden

name: HANNER bėgimas į dangoraižį „Europa“
location: Europa Tower, Vilnius, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The HANNER Run Up the Europa Skyscraper is a traditional annual challenge, inviting running enthusiasts and extreme sports fans to climb all 31 floors of the Europa business centre, the tallest in the Baltic States. The event brings together professionals and amateurs looking to improve their endurance and athletic performance. The course must be completed in no more than 10 minutes, while prize winners usually finish in 3–4 minutes. The fastest runners receive cash prizes and gifts from sponsors.
course_highlights: 31 floors of the business centre up to the terrace
Course completion time: up to 10 minutes
Records stand at 2 min. 55.6 sec. in the men’s category and 3 min. 28.6 sec. in the women’s category
additional: Participants start every half-minute to avoid congestion. The fastest runners receive cash prizes and gifts from sponsors. The event is organised by real estate development company Hanner and the Lithuanian Running Cup team. The event is scheduled for May 22, 2027, and welcomes participants from across Lithuania and abroad. Participants are invited to climb Europa Tower, and the event is known as one of the most interesting and challenging running events in Vilnius.

name: XIII Olecka Trzynastka
description: XIII Olecka Trzynastka to coroczny bieg odbywający się na Stadionie Miejskim w Olecku. Zawody obejmują bieg główny oraz nordic walking, przyciągając zarówno biegaczy, jak i miłośników aktywności na świeżym powietrzu. Impreza ma charakter otwarty i przyjazny dla uczestników, z jasno określonymi opłatami startowymi i profesjonalną organizacją. Start zaplanowano na godzinę 08:30, a wydarzenie trwa do 14:20.

name: Kajenloppet
organizer: Nacka Hockey Friidrott i samarbete med Kajen i Nacka Strand
description: Kajenloppet is a running experience along the waterfront in Nacka Strand, suitable for the whole family. The race is organised by Nacka Hockey Friidrott in collaboration with Kajen in Nacka Strand, with a focus on the joy of movement, community and local engagement. The course offers beautiful views of the inlet and takes runners past Svindersvik and around Kvarnholmen before the finish at Kajen. There are distances for everyone, from children’s races to longer routes, and the event is a lively celebration full of energy and spectators.
course_highlights: Run along the waterfront with views of the inlet
The course passes Svindersvik and loops around Kvarnholmen
Start and finish at Kajen in Nacka Strand
additional: The 400 m children’s race starts at 10:30, and the 1,200 m children’s race starts at 11:30. Kajenloppet is a lively celebration full of energy, spectators and community. Kajen also offers activities such as mini golf and pétanque near the event area. Previous editions have included 6 km and 10 km races as well as children’s races; distances and arrangements may vary from year to year.

name: Adelsö ultra
description: A new ultratrail race on Adelsö on 16 May 2027. Adelsö is one of the Mälaren islands on the outskirts of Stockholm. We have worked hard on the course and are proud to present a scenic marathon-distance XL that combines coastline and technical forest trails with 600 metres of climbing. Beyond the natural experience, the race offers a journey through historically significant landscapes, which we have made an effort to highlight along the route. One of the most exciting ultraraces in Stockholm in spring 2027 for those who love trail running.

name: Vårruset Stockholm
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Vårruset Stockholm is a popular spring running event held on Norra Djurgården, with distances of 2.5 and 5 km. The event offers a lovely spring evening with timing, a medal, a finish-line goodie bag, and a music quiz with prizes. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggan/Universitetet, and the event has a friendly atmosphere, with teams able to enjoy a picnic after finishing. This recreational race welcomes both individual runners and teams, with a focus on fun and community.
course_highlights: Course on Norra Djurgården, starting on Fiskartorpsvägen
Distance options of 2.5 km and 5 km; the 5 km course is officially measured
Start and finish on the grass area at Stora Skuggan/Universitetet
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register early; otherwise, they must be collected on site. Teams consist of 5 people and receive a picnic after finishing. Changing rooms and showers are available for a fee at Frescati Sports Center. The event area is easily accessible by public transport and bicycle. Parking is limited and subject to a fee.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 1 etapas
description: The Jonava Running Cup is a traditional running competition held in Jonava District to promote sport and physical activity. The event is open to all runners from Lithuania and abroad and takes place in five stages at different locations. Participants compete in both the overall standings and age groups, while the routes pass through various parts of Jonava District, offering an interesting and varied running experience. Registration is online, and race numbers can be collected at the start location on race day.
course_highlights: Five stages at different locations in Jonava District: Šilai–Jaugeliškiai, Ragožiai, Juškonys, Salupiai–Bartoniai, Jonava
Starts and finishes at various locations, including Jonava Central Stadium and eldership buildings
Races take place in the evening, with the start at 19:30 and race-number collection from 18:30 to 19:20
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the start location on race day from 18:30 to 19:20. Registration is carried out separately for each stage. Participation is free. The event is open to all participants, offers online registration and different routes, and takes place in five stages from May to September.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten takes place on Wednesday, 20 May 2026, in Folkparken in Norrköping. Four people form a team and take turns walking, jogging or running a lively 4 km leg each. There are classes with and without timing, and the race is promoted as an accessible, festive relay for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and young people can take part completely free of charge, and there is special information for schools.

name: Vårruset (Falun)
description: Vårruset is Sweden’s largest recreational running tour for women—a fun and welcoming spring evening where participants can run, jog or walk 2.5 or 5 km. The event tours 19 cities from 4 May to 4 June 2026, and Falun is one of the locations. All participants receive, among other things, a medal and a race bib, while teams of five are rewarded with a picnic after finishing. The race has been held since 1989 and is aimed at recreational runners of different ages, in line with the recommendations for each distance.

name: Blodomloppet (Karlskrona)

description: Blodomloppet in Karlskrona is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event also offers an 800-metre children’s race and a dedicated 5 km walking course. The courses are officially measured and approved for competition, and the event ends with a shared picnic for all participants. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity for both individual participants and teams, with special discounts for blood donors and ICA members.
course_highlights: Four different courses: 5 km run, 10 km run, 800 m children’s race and 5 km walk
The courses are measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Federation
Walkers have a separate course and start first to make it possible for everyone to enjoy a shared picnic afterwards
additional: The event offers special discounts of SEK 40 per person for blood donors and ICA members, for both individual entries and teams. You can register individually or in a team of up to 5 participants. Team members can take part in different distances/classes. There is an option to register many participants using an Excel template, and larger organisations can use customer pages to manage registrations. Walkers start first on a separate course to make it possible to enjoy a shared picnic after the event.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is a 5 km evening race starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race follows a 2.5 km loop run twice, with a pleasant setting and a great atmosphere along the course. You can participate individually or register a team (at least five people), with the five fastest results combined. Welcome to the running festival in Stadsparken on Wednesday, 20 May 2026 at 19:00.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.vasterviksok.se/arrangemang/vasterviksfemman/): 2027-05-19 — "Stadsparken 19.00 onsdagen 19 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-19)

name: Kėdainių bėgimas „Babėnų pavasaris 2026“
location: Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelė, Kėdainiai, Lithuania
description: The Kėdainiai race “Babėnų Spring 2026” invites all active-lifestyle enthusiasts to take part in the 5 km and 10 km distances at the Babėnai Forest recreation area. The event aims to encourage physical activity among participants of all ages and provide an opportunity to compete and put their running abilities to the test. The courses follow forest trails and paths, and every finisher will receive a commemorative medal. The competition is organised in cooperation between the Kėdainiai Sports Centre and the Lithuanian Amateur Runners Association.
course_highlights: The courses follow trails and paths in Babėnai Forest
5 km and 10 km distances
The competition takes place at the Babėnai Forest recreation area, at the end of Aušros and Budrio streets
additional: Additional registration will be available at the start area from 17:00 to 18:15. Race numbers will be issued starting one hour before the start, with distribution ending 15 minutes before the start. Winners and runners-up in each age group will be awarded, as will the three fastest participants in the 5 km and 10 km distances. All finishers will receive commemorative medals. The event is planned for 26 May 2027, but no details about the courses or entry fee have been provided.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
organizer: Blodcentralen i Östergötland och IK Akele samt Blodtappen i Östergötland

description: Blodomloppet in Linköping is a fun run that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. The event is open to both individual participants and teams. Teams can consist of 3–5 people, and team members can choose different distances. Blodomloppet is a social, health-promoting activity that ends with a large picnic and has a strong focus on attracting new blood donors. Youth teams receive a discount, and blood donors are offered a special discount on the entry fee. Participants also have the opportunity to travel free of charge on public transport in Östergötland on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances for women and men
The race takes place in Linköping, with the start and finish in central areas
Water stations are available along the course
additional: All participants who register by 14 May and provide a mobile number will receive a ticket link by text message for six hours of free public transport in Östergötland on 21 May. Teams must have 3–5 people, and the entry fee is always charged for five people, even if the team is smaller. Bib collection and late registration are available at several locations in the days before the race. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person, both for individual entries and team entries.

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden’s largest women’s fitness tour and takes place on Thursday, May 21, 2026, starting at 19:00 at Lögastrand. The event offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and is suitable for both experienced runners and those who want to jog or walk. Everyone who registers individually receives a medal, a finish-line goody bag, and a race number; teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. Timing is available for the 5 km distance, but can be opted out of during registration if you do not want your result published.

description: Stigtomtaloppet is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta, welcoming all age groups and runners, from children to adults, including a new dog category. The race offers distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km on a mix of paved roads, forest trails and residential streets. It is a popular recreational race that also features team competitions with a picnic after the race, bringing participants together. Since starting in 2012, the race has grown to become the largest in the Nyköping region and is known for its friendly, inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course on paved roads, forest trails and residential streets
Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill
Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish
additional: Start and finish at ICA Nära in Stigtomta. Participant bags with race bibs and timing chips must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start. Team competitions have a mass start and include a picnic basket (no special diets). The dog category has its own start time and prize table. A refreshment tent serving fika and accepting card payments is available. Parking with guidance and bicycle parking are available. Timed hill sprint on the steepest hill. Prizes along the course that participants can take with them to the finish.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas „Laisvės taku 2026“
description: The traditional “Laisvės taku 2026” run will take place on May 22, 2026, in the town of Šimkaičiai, Jurbarkas District, to mark the 117th anniversary of the birth of General Jonas Žemaitis. This is an 11 km cross-country race starting at General Jonas Žemaitis’s command post. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and honours the memory of a Lithuanian freedom fighter. Participants are invited to register in advance and take part in this community sporting event.
course_highlights: An 11 km cross-country race in the Šimkaičiai area
Start at General Jonas Žemaitis’s command post
Bus transport to the start from Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School
additional: Participant registration is open from 9:00 to 9:30. Bib pickup is on 2025-05-23 from 9:00 to 9:30. Registration venue: Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School. The bus to the start leaves from the school at 09:45. Awards are scheduled for 13:00. Participants must have a doctor’s permission or have had a health check. Results will be published publicly. Photos and video footage will be taken during the event for marketing purposes. The event will take place at Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School; age groups and online registration are available.

name: Ludvika stadslopp
description: Ludvika Stadslopp is organised by Ludvika FFI and is a family-friendly road race with several distances for both children and adults. The start and finish are at Charlie Normans torg, and the event includes a children’s race, the Lilla Stadsloppet, and 5 km and 10 km races (with or without timing). The event takes place on Saturday, 23 May 2026, and welcomes runners of all ages and levels. There is a bonus for the 10 km course linked to the course record.

name: VirsboRUN
description: Welcome to VirsboRUN—a family-friendly trail race at Skräddartorpet on Saturday, May 23, 2026. Choose to run 1–4 laps of the 5.3 km loop course (up to 21.2 km), or let the children take part in the free kids’ race of approximately 800 metres. The course passes through unspoiled nature and Hälleskogsbrännan, with varied trails and beautiful views. After crossing the finish line, participants can look forward to a medal and a freshly grilled hamburger.

name: Å-Varvet
description: Å-Varvet is a classic running race in Eskilstuna, offering a scenic and varied course along the water and through the city’s parks. The race is popular and appreciated by both elite runners and recreational runners, with a great atmosphere and crowd support along the entire route. It’s a perfect event for anyone looking to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings while enjoying Eskilstuna’s charm.
course_highlights: The course runs along Eskilstuna’s waterways and through its parks
Varied terrain featuring both asphalt and gravel
Crowd support along the entire course

name: If Vilniaus Pusmaratonis 2026
description: The “If” Vilnius Half Marathon is Vilnius’s biggest spring running festival, held in the city’s Old Town. The event welcomes runners of all ages, from children to half-marathon participants. It promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and community spirit. Participants can feel safe knowing that all runners are insured against accidents. The event features a range of distances and a friendly atmosphere that helps build lasting connections among participants.
course_highlights: Start at Cathedral Square in Vilnius Old Town
Half-marathon distance: 21.098 km
Children’s and youth races for different age groups
additional: Participants who register by April 4 receive personalized bibs. Event T-shirts are available for an additional fee. The event includes children’s races starting from age 2, a 4.2 km youth race, and 5 km and 10 km distances with no age limits. Participants receive race packs with a timing chip. The event program includes warm-ups and awards for each distance. Runners of various age groups take part, with several start times and additional activities in Vilnius and the Old Town.

name: Atviros „Trakų Dainiaus bėgimo taurės“ 1000 m rungties varžybos
location: Trakų stadionas, Trakai, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The open 1000 m event of the “Trakai Dainius Running Cup” is an official 1000-meter race held at Trakai Stadium. The event is for both young athletes and recreational runners who want to test their speed and experience a true sporting atmosphere. The competition takes place in a professionally prepared setting, with a clearly marked stadium track. It is a great opportunity to challenge yourself in a classic running event and enjoy the spirit of sport in Trakai.
course_highlights: 1000-meter distance on the stadium athletics track
Professionally prepared stadium course
The competition takes place at Trakai Stadium, Birutės St. 44
additional: Registration is available by email at drasutisbarkauskas@gmail.com. The event takes place at Trakai Stadium, Birutės St. 44. This is an official 1000 m event for both young athletes and recreational runners. The event is included in the endurance sports calendar, and participants can compete and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in Trakai.

name: Bėgimo varžybos Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio r. Kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams laimėti
organizer: Kupiškio r. kūno kultūros ir sporto centras
description: The running competition for the prizes of Pavel Fedorenka and the Kupiškis District Physical Education and Sports Centre invites participants to register and compete. The event is held in Kupiškis to promote sporting activity and community spirit. It is a great opportunity to test your abilities and enjoy running in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The event is open to all age groups
Compete for prizes from Pavel Fedorenka and the Kupiškis District Physical Education and Sports Centre
Location: Kupiškis, Lithuania
additional: The event will take place on May 29, 2027. Registration is available online and via social media.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia - edycja wiosenna 2026 to bieg przełajowy organizowany w malowniczym Leśnym Ogrodzie Botanicznym Marszewo w Gdyni. Impreza jest częścią cyklu biegów Botaniczna Piątka, które od 2014 roku promują bieganie i piękno naturalnych tras w Polsce. Bieg przyciąga pasjonatów biegania, którzy cenią sobie kontakt z przyrodą i estetykę otoczenia. To doskonała okazja, by aktywnie spędzić czas na świeżym powietrzu wśród zieleni i wyjątkowej atmosfery.

name: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach
description: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach to coroczna impreza biegowa organizowana przez Nadleśnictwo Wichrowo, która przyciąga miłośników aktywnego spędzania czasu na łonie natury. Głównym wydarzeniem jest bieg na dystansie 10 km, który odbywa się na malowniczych terenach leśnych. Dodatkowo organizowane są biegi dla dzieci i młodzieży, osób z niepełnosprawnością intelektualną oraz marsz nordic walking. Start i meta zlokalizowane są przy siedzibie Nadleśnictwa Wichrowo, a uczestnicy mają możliwość udziału w treningu zapoznawczym z trasą.

name: Stadionloppet
description: Stadionloppet is a family-friendly running event held at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The main race is 5 km long and takes place on a scenic two-lap course created by Kalle Berglund. The event is marked by a wonderful sense of community, where children, young people and adults can all take part and cheer one another on. The start, lap point and finish are at the beautiful stadium, offering a unique running experience in a setting where the buzz of the city meets greenery and birdsong.
course_highlights: 5 km two-lap course around Stockholm Olympic Stadium
Course created by Kalle Berglund, a former world-class runner
Start, lap point and finish at Stockholm Olympic Stadium
additional: All members of Djurgården Friidrott run for free and receive a registration code when they join. Several shorter distances are available for children and young people. Members can also take part as volunteers and be part of the event. Start times and categories are preliminary and may change. Stadiongirot, a cycling race held in collaboration with Djurgården Cykel, also takes place on the same day. Members of Djurgården Friidrott can run for free with a registration code. Distance and category details for 2027 are preliminary and may change. Free trial training on the course is held ahead of the race.

name: Bėgam už Marijampolę - 2026
description: Bėgam už Marijampolę is a traditional annual running event held in Marijampolė, bringing together participants of all ages. It is not only a competition but also an outdoor gathering for local residents that encourages an active lifestyle and a sense of community. The event features an updated running course where participants can test their endurance in a beautiful Lithuanian city. It also includes the “Einam už Marijampolę” walking tour, with 8 km and 14 km distances and free registration.
course_highlights: Updated running course in Marijampolė
Walking tour with 8 km and 14 km distances
Outdoor event that encourages a sense of community
additional: The “Einam už Marijampolę” walking tour takes place alongside the running event, and registration for the tour is free. The event brings together more than 1,000 participants, from the youngest to the oldest. Organized by the Marijampolė Athletics Sports Club. Event date: May 30, 2027; participant numbers and race distances are not specified.

name: Vårruset Jönköping
organizer: Marathongruppen med Hässelby SK och Spårvägens FK
description: Vårruset in Jönköping is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women, where participants can run, jog or walk 2.5 or 5 km on a certified course. The event is all about the joy of movement and togetherness, with a wonderful atmosphere among women. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and a finish-line bag, and teams of five are treated to a picnic after the finish. It’s a festive spring evening with entertainment and encouragement along the course and at the event area by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
Event area by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken
additional: You can opt out of timekeeping when registering, which means your result will not be published in the results list. Teams of five are treated to a picnic after the finish. The recommended age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km, with younger participants permitted when accompanied by an adult. Registration is binding and can be completed up to one hour before the first start on race day. All participants who finish receive a medal and a finish-line bag. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish.

The event is part of Sweden’s largest fun run series, with a strong focus on health and social connection, and traditionally ends with a large picnic. description: Gladsheim Finspång City Race is an annual fun run through beautiful Finspång, starting and finishing in Bruksparken. The race offers a 7-kilometre course with smooth, even surfaces, ideal for both runners and recreational participants. For a shorter challenge, there is AktivRundan, approximately 3.8 kilometres with no timing, and children can take part in XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan, a 1.7-kilometre route through an easy-to-run park setting. All participants receive a medal and energy products, and there are great prizes to be won. The race is open to everyone, whether they walk, jog or run.
course_highlights: 7 km course with smooth, even surfaces through central Finspång
AktivRundan: 3.8 km without timing for walkers and joggers
XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan: 1.7 km for children through an easy-to-run park setting
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday, 26 May, between 15:00 and 19:00. Late registration is available at the bib collection point and at the start and finish area from 15:00 on race day. Timing uses a chip on the race bib tab; without it, no time will be recorded. The children’s race has four start times between 17:00 and 18:00, depending on age group. All participants receive a medal, energy products and a water bottle sponsored by local businesses. The children’s race prize-giving takes place on the stage in Bruksparken at 18:15. The race’s official website currently provides information about the 2026 edition; prices and practical details for 2027 have not been specified.

description: Gladsheim Finspång City Run is an annual celebration of recreational running through beautiful Finspång, starting and finishing in Bruksparken. The event offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including a 7 km course for adults, the 3.8 km AktivRundan for walkers and joggers, and the 1.7 km XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan for children. It’s a community event where recreational runners and competitive runners alike can take part and enjoy a scenic course with even surfaces and crowd support. All participants receive a medal and energy products, and there are great prizes to be won thanks to generous sponsors.
course_highlights: 7 km course through central Finspång with even, well-maintained surfaces
AktivRundan, approximately 3.8 km, for walkers and joggers; no timing
XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan, 1.7 km, on an easy-to-run park course for children

The children’s race prize ceremony takes place on the stage in Bruksparken at 18:15, with special prizes for the top three in each class (except the youngest). The children can also take part in the 1.7 km XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan. Prices and times are based on information published for 2026; information for 2027 is unavailable.

Blodomloppet is a social and healthy activity that ends with a shared picnic and helps promote blood donation and youth sports in the region.

description: Blodomloppet in Örebro is a fun run that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes everyone to walk, jog or run with friends, family or colleagues. The event offers several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, Specialomloppet and Lilla Blodomloppet for children. It is a social, healthy activity that also promotes team spirit and wellbeing, with the option to take part in teams of five. After the race, participants often gather for a picnic, and the event area is well equipped for an enjoyable day for the whole family.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses for women and men
Specialomloppet, approximately 2.1 km
Lilla Blodomloppet: approximately 750 m or 2.1 km for children aged 1–12
additional: You can register individually or as a team of five, with the option to fill vacant places later. Discounts are available for blood donors and ICA Stammis members (SEK 40), but not during late registration. There is no age limit for the 5 km and 10 km distances, but participants should be able to complete the course on their own or accompanied by an adult. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children aged 1–12, and adults may accompany them as long as they do not disturb others. A large picnic is offered to participants after the race. You can use your wellness allowance when registering. The race takes place at Trängens IP. You can register individually or as a team of five. Participants receive, among other things, a T-shirt, race bib and medal; prices vary depending on the distance and registration date.

There is also a shorter children’s event, Lilla Blodomloppet, covering approximately 800 metres. Blodomloppet is a social health and fitness activity that ends with a shared picnic and aims to promote health and blood donation in the community.

The walking route has no finish arch and ends at the fruit and medal tables in central Borlänge
Lilla Blodomloppet covers approximately 800 metres in the area around the event site
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (3–5 participants). Team members can take part in different distances. Team participants receive a picnic bag. Late registration for teams closes on 21 May, and for individual participants on 28 May at 12:00. Changes can be made by email or at bib collection for a fee. Bibs are distributed at Friskis&Svettis on 26 May from 16:30 to 18:30. A small kiosk offering Swish payments is available at the event site. There are water stations along the route. Teams consist of 3–5 participants, and team registration includes a picnic bag. Individual registration is also available. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person.

description: Vårruset in Örebro is a popular spring running event offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km on a course measured for accuracy. The race is open to all ages, with a recommended minimum age of 7 for the shorter distance when accompanied by an adult, and 11 for the longer distance. Participants receive a medal, a race bag, a race number, and the option of timekeeping for the 5 km. Teams that register are offered a shared picnic after the finish, creating a lovely social spring evening at Gustavsviksbadet. The event is all about community and enjoyment, with activities and a music quiz for participants.
course_highlights: Course measured for accuracy: 5 km
Start and finish at Gustavsviksbadet
Water station and toilets at the event area
additional: Race-number collection takes place at Intersport Marieberg in the days leading up to the race. Picnic for teams of 5 after the finish. The event area is at Gustavsvik Camping, where parking is limited; participants are encouraged to travel in an environmentally friendly way. Changing at home is recommended. A water station and toilets are available on site. Participants can leave warm-up clothes in a bag marked with their name and race number. Race information is sent by email approximately two weeks before the event. Timekeeping is available as an optional extra for the 5 km. For the 2.5 km, the recommended minimum age is 11, or 7 when accompanied by an adult; for the 5 km, the recommended minimum age is 13, or 11 when accompanied by an adult. Information for Örebro 2027 has not been confirmed in the sources.

name: 3. Benno Viirandi nimeline rahvajooks
description: 3. Benno Viirandi nimeline rahvajooks on perekeskne jooksu- ja kepikõnniüritus, mis toimub Mustla alevikus. Võistlus toimub 5 km pikkusel rajal, mis algab Soe küla Vambola bussijaama juurest ja lõpeb Tarvastu Gümnaasiumi staadionil. Ürituse eesmärk on austada legendaarse jooksumehe Benno Viirandi mälestust ning populariseerida jooksmist kui tervislikku ajaveetmise viisi. Lisaks põhijooksule toimuvad lastejooksud staadionil, mis on tasuta. Osalejatele on tagatud võistlusnumbrid ja võimalus registreeruda nii eelnevalt kui ka võistluspäeval kohapeal.

name: Eksjö Stadslopp
description: Eksjö Stadslopp is a community race that welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The race takes you through the beautiful wooden town of Eksjö and offers a wonderful running experience filled with energy, community and joy. Proceeds from the race go to Eksjö Södra IK’s children’s and youth activities, so taking part also supports a good cause. The start and finish are at Stora Torget in Eksjö, and the event has a friendly, inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: The race goes through one of Sweden’s most beautiful wooden towns
The course is available in several distances, including 10 km and 5 km fun runs
Start and finish at Stora Torget in Eksjö
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Snäckan beside the swimming pool. Changing facilities are available at Prästängshallen until 21:30 on race day. Start times vary by class, with children’s races starting from 18:00 onwards; the men’s and women’s 10 km races start at 19:30, and the 5 km fun run starts at 19:50. Group registration is available by email, with invoicing. Results are published on the club’s website after the race. The race programme also includes a 1,000-metre youth race and a 600-metre children’s race. Proceeds support Eksjö Södra IK’s children’s and youth activities.

name: adidas Shake Out Run
description: The adidas Shake Out Run is a 5 km race starting and finishing at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. It’s a perfect warm-up for participants running the Stockholm Marathon the following day, as well as an opportunity for other runners to experience the unique marathon atmosphere during the event weekend. The first 1,000 people to register will receive an adidas T-shirt in their chosen size to run in, distributed at the event. After the race, people who register later can also collect T-shirts in the remaining sizes.
course_highlights: 5 km distance, starting and finishing at Stockholm Olympic Stadium
The race serves as a warm-up for the Stockholm Marathon
A unique marathon atmosphere during the event weekend
additional: Age limit: 13 years (11 years when accompanied by a parent or guardian). Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start. Payment options include online banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, and invoice via Klarna. The event is organised by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK. The age limit is 13 years, or 11 years when accompanied by a parent or guardian. Late registration can be completed online until one hour before the first start.

name: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve
description: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve on traditsiooniline 6,5 km pikkune jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub 30. mail 2026 Harku järve rannas. Võistlus kuulub 2026 Maru Järvejooksude sarja ja on selle teine osavõistlus. Rajal on joogipunktid ning see on tähistatud ja turvatud rajajulgestusmeeskonna poolt. Lisaks jooksjatele on oodatud ka kepikõndijad ja käijad, kes stardivad viimases grupis. Võistluskeskus asub start-finišipaigas, kus toimub ka numbrite väljastamine ja autasustamine.

name: Koeru kergejõustikuvõistlused
description: Koeru kergejõustikuvõistlused on traditsiooniline kergejõustiku võistlus, mis toimub Koeru KK staadionil. Võistlusel osalevad mehed ja naised kahes vanusegrupis ning võisteldakse mitmetel aladel, sealhulgas 100 m jooks, kaugushüpe, kuulitõuge, kettaheide, odavise ja 1000 m jooks. Võitja selgitatakse kolme parema ala punktide liitmise teel. Võistlus on avatud kõigile ja pakub võimalust osaleda kõigil aladel, kus noored kasutavad oma vanuseklassile vastavaid heitevahendeid.

name: Maardu kevadjooks
description: Maardu kevadjooks ja tervisekäimine on traditsiooniline spordipäev, mis toimub Maardus ja toob kokku liikumishuvilised igas vanuses. Üritusel on mitmed jooksud ja tervisekõnnid erinevatele vanusegruppidele ja võimekusele, sealhulgas lastejooksud, noortejooks, erivajadustega inimeste matk ning 3 ja 5 kilomeetri jooksud. Osalemine on tasuta ning iga lõpetaja saab medali. Ürituse eesmärk on pakkuda liikumisrõõmu, hea enesetunde ja aktiivset päeva värskes õhus, rõhutades perede ja sõprade koosveedetud aega.

name: jooks ümber Harku järve
description: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve toimub 30. mail 2026 Tallinnas Harku järve rannas. Tegemist on 6,5 km pikkuse jooksuga, mis kuulub 2026 Maru Järvejooksude sarja ja on selle sarja teine osavõistlus. Lisaks jooksjatele on oodatud ka kepikõndijad ja käijad, kes stardivad viimases grupis. Rajal on joogipunktid ning võistluskeskus pakub lisaks jooksule ka laste kergejõustiku töötuba ja pop-up poode. Osalejatele tagatakse medal, ajavõtt kiibiga, spordijook ja vesi rajal ning autasustamine.

name: adidas Stockholm Marathon
description: The adidas Stockholm Marathon is a classic marathon that takes place this year on 30 May 2026 and attracts both elite and recreational runners. The race is 42,195 metres long, measured according to current regulations, and follows a new course through central Stockholm. The event is organised by athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the organisers highlight extensive runner services along the course. The race starts at Stockholm Olympic Stadium and offers seeding opportunities through events including adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan.
course_highlights: 42,195 metres, measured according to the Swedish Athletics Association and IAAF
New course through central Stockholm (including Sveavägen and Kungsgatan), passing through the city
World-class runner services along the entire course
additional: Start and finish area: Lidingövägen outside the clock tower at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The race starts in two waves, at 12:00 and 12:10. The marathon time limit is 6.5 hours, and there are four checkpoints with cut-off times along the course. Seeding: the deadline for submitting a time for seeding is 3 May 2026; adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan count towards seeding. adidas Premiärmilen (10 km) takes place in Norra Djurgården, has a total elevation gain of 117 m, mixed surfaces and a provisional start time of 11:00; the time limit is 2 hours and the contact for Premiärmilen is info@premiarmilen.se. The event is organised by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the website is provided by Marathongruppen i Stockholm AB. The event is sold out for 30 May 2026. The course runs through central Stockholm and finishes at Stockholm Olympic Stadium; runners can also take part in related Adidas events such as Premiärmilen, Premiärhalvan and Shake Out Run.

name: Backyard Ultra Vänge
description: The loop is a real gem, if we may say so ourselves—a slice of Uppland at its best. The race hub is High Chaparral Park, with its large green spaces: a natural race base in the heart of the community of Vänge. Backyard Ultra Vänge will draw spectators along the course, which awaits you dressed in lovely spring attire. We have taken care to create a varied and somewhat challenging course. The result is an experience where something is always happening and the running never gets monotonous. Large parts of the race take place on the slightly bumpy trail on the outskirts of the community. You’ll feel as if you’re flying over soft ground beneath big trees and past colossal rocks. Several national-team runners began their running careers here, and many prominent floorball players have sweated through hard training sessions. An oasis in the forest—with a glimpse of Highway 72. A road tunnel takes you beneath the highway and into the unique Uppland rowing village of Vänge-Ekeby. The village, which has been a listed building since 1998, has medieval origins and a preserved village layout. Vänge Hembygdsförening has given the village an active cultural life and attracted many visitors. The course winds through this fantastic setting. Take the opportunity to enjoy the atmosphere and a glimpse of society as it once was. Then it’s back beneath the highway and into the forest on small trails. Before you know it, you’re back in the community and looping around High Chaparral. Take a short rest and perhaps enjoy some of the energizing snacks on offer. Then you’re off again. Wonderful!

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.backyardvange.se/): 2027-05-29 — "Kommande lopp planerat den 29 maj 2027" (was estimated 2027-05-22)

name: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra
organizer: Highland Trail Club och Höglandskyrkan i Sävsjö
description: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra is a welcoming race in the deepest forests of Småland, featuring a scenic, hilly 6.7 km backyard loop and a 3.7 km loop suitable for children and recreational runners. The event is organized by Highland Trail Club and Höglandskyrkan in Sävsjö, with a focus on community and charity; all proceeds go to charitable causes. The number of laps is limited to 15, creating a challenging but fun experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Hilly 6.7 km backyard loop in the forests of Småland
3.7 km loop suitable for children and recreational runners
Nature-focused race with a charitable purpose
additional: The event runs from Saturday at 09:00 to Sunday at 00:00. The number of laps is limited to 15. All proceeds from the event go to charitable causes. Backyard laps start on the hour. Sources state that the 2026 edition started on Saturday at 09:00; information about the 2027 start time is unavailable.

name: Blue Mountain Trail Run
price_range: 150–550 kr beroende på distans och anmälningstid

price_tiers.distance: 15 km - Alvars stig by Nordväggen AB
6 km - Östra Ånnabodasjön by ICA Glansen

description:
Blue Mountain TrailRun is a trail race in Kilsbergen, 20 kilometres west of Örebro. Four courses of 6, 10, 15 and 21 km, all starting and finishing at First Camp Ånnaboda.

The courses follow Bergslagsleden and the MTB trails around Ånnaboda: narrow paths, roots and rocks, boardwalks over streams, moss-covered spruce forest and views over forest lakes. The 21 km Blankhult course has 527 metres of elevation gain and is the race’s long loop, for those looking for technical trails and hills. The 15 km Alvars stig is the middle distance, with trails all the way. The 10 km Trolldalsvägen is the classic 10-kilometre course. The 6 km Östra Ånnabodasjön course loops around the lake on mostly easy-to-run trails and is suitable as a first trail race.
