name: Friday Night Run 2026
description: Friday Night Run on energiline ööjooks Tartu südalinnas, mis toimub 2. oktoobril Raekoja platsil. Distants on ligikaudu 4 km, mis kulgeb linnatänavatel ja pakub võimalust nautida sügisese linna atmosfääri koos sõpradega. Jooks ei ole võistlus, osalejad saavad valida ajavõtuga või ajavõtuta läbimise vahel. Üritust saadab muusika ja live kontsert, mis loob meeleoluka õhtuse atmosfääri.
course_highlights: Ligikaudu 4 km pikkune rada Tartu südalinnas
Rada kulgeb linnatänavatel ja pargiradadel
Üks vaheajavõtu punkt ajavõtuga distantsil
additional: Stardinumber peab olema kinnitatud rinnale ja nähtav kogu distantsi vältel. Ajavõtukiip on kinnitatud stardinumbri tagaküljele ja on ühekordse kasutusega. Raja läbimiseks on aega 45 minutit, finiš suletakse kell 21:45. Osavõtutasu sisaldab tähistatud rada, stardinumbrit, ajavõttu (kui on kiip), teenindust finišis ja vajadusel meditsiiniabi. Registreerimine toimub veebis kuni 2. oktoober kell 17:00 ja kohapeal kuni kell 20:30. Event includes registration online and on-site, with medals and T-shirts for participants, and group discounts available

name: 15. Tartu Linnamaratoni Lastejooksud
description: Tartu Linnamaratoni lastejooksud on kõigile lastele avatud jooksuvõistlus, kus osalemisrõõm on peamine eesmärk. Distantside ja vanusegruppide osas on soovituslikud juhised, kuid iga laps on rajal oodatud ja võrdne. Stardinumbrid väljastatakse tund enne starti ning võistlust ei korraldata paremusjärjestuse alusel. Üritus toimub Tartu Raekoja platsil ning pakub võimalust osaleda nii eelregistreerunult kui ka kohapeal.

name: Loimaan Lenkki
description: Loimaan Lenkki on syksyinen juoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään Loimaan keskustassa. Tapahtumassa on tarjolla neljä eri matkaa: 1,2 km, 2,4 km, 5,2 km ja 10,4 km, joten se sopii monenlaisille juoksijoille. Lähtöpaikka on Viljavarastontie 4 ja tapahtuma tarjoaa mukavan mahdollisuuden liikkua ja nauttia yhteisöllisyydestä. Ilmoittautuminen on avoinna, ja tapahtuman järjestää Loimaan Seudun Nuorkauppakamari.

name: KOMIA Esi-Talvijuoksusarja
description: KOMIA Esi-Talvijuoksusarja on talvinen kuusiosainen juoksusarja, joka tarjoaa kaikentasoisille juoksijoille mahdollisuuden testata ja seurata kuntonsa kehitystä. Sarjan reitit lähtevät Pajuluoman koululta ja ovat nopeat sekä tasaiset, tarjoten 2 km, 5 km ja 10 km matkat. Sarja alkaa Esi-Talvijuoksulla lokakuun alussa ja jatkuu kevääseen asti. Sarjan päätteeksi parhaat palkitaan, ja juoksut sopivat hyvin niin kuntoilijoille kuin kilpaileville juoksijoillekin.

name: Keurusselän Syyslenkki
description: Keurusselän Syyslenkki on monipuolinen syksyinen tapahtuma Keuruun kauniissa maisemissa, jossa voi osallistua polkujuoksuun tai maastopyöräilyyn. Polkujuoksussa on kaksi lenkkiä, 6,4 km ja 12 km, ja maastopyöräilyssä useita matkoja eri sarjoissa, mukaan lukien lasten ja sähköpyöräsarjat. Tapahtuma tarjoaa myös lasten lenkit ja mahdollisuuden nauttia hotellin kylpylästä osanottomaksun yhteydessä. Reitit kulkevat Resort Keurusselän ja Montosvuoren maastoissa, tarjoten mäkijuoksua ja teknisesti vaihtelevia polkuja. Osallistujat voivat nauttia myös hotellin ravintolan tarjouksista tapahtumapäivänä.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, very hilly trail race held at the IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget in Huskvarna. The race offers several distances for both adults and children, with a varied course that follows trails and, in places, untamed terrain. Participants can enjoy beautiful views over Lake Vättern and challenging hills, including the famous Strutsabacken, where the Bergatrollet competition takes place. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with activities and a sense of community around the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Tough, hilly terrain with both trails and untamed sections
Passage through Ulvadalen, with abundant flora and opportunities to experience nature
Strutsabacken—a steep ski slope where the Bergatrollet competition is decided
additional: Race bibs with timing chips must be collected from the IKHP cabin by 11:15. Timing is done using the chip in the race bib and provides both total time and Strutsabacken hill time. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the IKHP cabin. Water stations are located at several points, depending on the distance. Late registration is available on race day between 9:00 and 11:00, if places remain. IKHP members receive half off the fee with a discount code. The event is described as family-friendly, with refreshments and activities at the start and finish, as well as changing facilities and showers at the IKHP cabin.

name: Broloppet Motala

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

description: Broloppet Motala is a popular running race organized by Motala AIF Friidrott, with the start and finish in Stadsparken in Motala. The race features a newly revived course that runs through central Motala, offering a pleasant running experience in an urban setting. There are two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with a separate lane for runners completing the first lap of the 10 km race. Water stations are available at the bridge and at the lap point to provide runners with the best possible support.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, in central Motala
Newly revived course through the city centre
Water stations at the bridge (approx. 3 km) and at the lap point
additional: Late registration is available on race day, 3/10, from 10:00 to 12:30 at Team Sportia. Bib numbers can be collected at Team Sportia from Friday 2/10, 10:00–18:00, and Saturday 3/10, 10:00–12:30. Changing facilities are available at Actic Stora Torget. Bag drop-off is by the stage. The 10 km race has a separate lane for runners completing the first lap.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The Förbifartspremiären is a unique race held only once, giving participants the opportunity to run or walk on the new E4 between Hjulsta and Häggvik, both above and below ground. The race offers different classes and distances for all levels, from walking to racing, with the start and finish at the new Akalla interchange in Stockholm. It’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience where you get to be the first to set foot on the new road before it opens to traffic.
course_highlights: The race runs both above and below ground on the new E4 Förbifart Stockholm
Start and finish at the new Akalla interchange
In the recreational class, you can choose an exit after approximately 4, 7 or 12 km
additional: Race bibs are either mailed to participants’ homes or collected on site, depending on the participant’s address. The competitive class starts at 09:00, the recreational class has start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and the walking class Herr Gårman starts between 18:00 and 19:30. The maximum time for the competitive class is 1 hour and 30 minutes. Entry is personal and cannot be transferred. The event area is easiest to reach by metro to Akalla.

name: VII-asis Utenos hipodromo maratonas
description: VII-asis Utenos Hipodromo Maratonas vyks 2026 m. spalio 3 d. Utenoje, moderniame Baltijos šalių hipodrome. Renginyje siūloma net 7 distancijos: maratonas, pusmaratonis, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km, 1 km šeimų bėgimas ir 400 m vaikų bėgimas. Tai puiki galimybė tiek patyrusiems bėgikams, tiek šeimoms su vaikais aktyviai praleisti laiką ir išbandyti savo jėgas įvairiose trasose.

name: Hostruset

price_tiers.distance: 5 km Män, Kvinnor, PF19, Veteraner 50+ och Motion

description: Hostruset is a fast 5 km race and fun run held in Örebro, starting and finishing at Björkhagaskolan. The course follows cycle paths around Varbergaskogen and has been officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association. The race is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series and offers both competitive and recreational classes. There is also a 700-metre children’s race for the youngest participants. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. Due to limited parking, the organisers encourage carpooling or cycling.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on cycle paths around Varbergaskogen
Starts and finishes at Björkhagaskolan in Örebro
Officially measured by a course measurer in accordance with the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Start groups are being tested for the 5 km race: runners expecting to finish in over 25 minutes start at 12:30, and those expecting to finish in under 25 minutes start at 12:45. Race numbers are distributed on race day. Timing is done using transponders, which must be returned after the race; otherwise, a charge of 400 kr applies. The prize ceremony takes place in the start/finish area, with honorary prizes for the top 5 in Men/Women and the top 3 in PF19 and Veteran 50+. Changing rooms and showers are available at Björkhagaskolan. Parking is very limited; carpooling or cycling is recommended.

name: /M.Pirksaare/Türi Tehisjärve jooks, liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 11. etapp
description: Türi Tehisjärve jooks on osa 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksude sarjast, mis pakub mitmekesiseid jooksuvõimalusi erinevatele vanuseklassidele. Rada kulgeb ümber Rava tehisjärve, pakkudes vaheldusrikast pinnast liivast, mullast ja kruusast. Võistlusel autasustatakse parimaid jooksjaid ning see sobib nii harrastajatele kui ka noortele jooksusõpradele. Üritus toimub 7. oktoobril 2026 Rava järve ääres Järvamaal.

name: Dark Run Lahti
description: Dark Run Lahti on ainutlaatuinen elämysjuoksu, joka järjestetään pimenevässä syysillassa Salpausselän upeissa maisemissa. Tapahtuma tarjoaa 5 km ja 10 km matkat, jotka sopivat kaiken tasoisille liikkujille. Juoksijat kulkevat pääosin ulkoilureiteillä otsalamppujen valossa, ja tapahtumaan kuuluu myös vapaaehtoinen Pimeä Metsä -kauhuelämys, joka tuo jännitystä reitille. Tunnelmallinen tapahtumakeskus sijaitsee Lahden urheilukeskuksessa, ja juoksun jälkeen on palkintojenjako sekä arvontoja.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų kroso taurė
description: Ukmergės fabrikų kroso taurė 2026 yra penkių etapų sporto renginys, apimantis bėgimo kroso, MTB dviračių kroso ir rogainingo varžybas. Renginys vyksta Kopūstėlių miške Ukmergėje ir skirtas skatinti aktyvų laisvalaikį gamtoje bei populiarinti sportą įvairaus amžiaus dalyvių tarpe. Varžybų startas yra bendras visoms grupėms ir vyksta vakare, o dalyviai varžosi pagal amžiaus grupes ir rungčių tipus. Pagrindinis organizatorius yra VšĮ Sportas miške, o renginys remiamas kelių Ukmergės įmonių.

name: 42. Munamäe–Võru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: 42. Munamäe - Võru maastikujooks-kõnd on osa Võrumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisarjast, mis pakub mitmekesiseid distantsivalikuid nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele. Põhidistants kulgeb maastikul ja asfaltteedel, pakkudes vaheldusrikast rada Võru piirkonnas. Sarjas on ka lühemad distantsid ning mudilaste jooksud, mis sobivad igas vanuses osalejatele. Võistlus toimub SA Võru Spordikeskuse suusabaasis Kubijal, mis on tuntud oma kauni looduse ja hea rajatingimuste poolest.

name: Hercules Trail Run
description: Hercules Trail Run on kymmenennen kerran järjestettävä polkujuoksutapahtuma, joka kutsuu juoksijat kokemaan Porvoon upeimmat polut ja merelliset maisemat lokakuun raikkaudessa. Tapahtuma tarjoaa monipuolisia reittivaihtoehtoja kaiken kuntoisille, aina 2 km lasten Polkurallista aina 42 km polkujuoksuun. Kisapäivä alkaa lasten Polkurallilla ja jatkuu useilla eri matkoilla, jotka kiertävät kauniita ja vaihtelevia polkuja Porvoon alueella. Osallistumismaksu sisältää monipuoliset palvelut ja tapahtuman aikana otetaan valokuva- ja videomateriaalia, jota käytetään tapahtuman tiedottamisessa.

name: Säkylänharjun polkujuoksu
description: Säkylänharjun polkujuoksu järjestetään lauantaina 10.10.2026 Huovinrinteen ampumahiihtokeskuksessa Säkylässä. Tapahtuma tarjoaa polkujuoksun ystäville monipuoliset reitit, jotka kulkevat muun muassa Klopin montun kautta. Kilpailukeskus sijaitsee helposti saavutettavassa paikassa, ja tapahtuma on tunnettu hyväksi todetusta konseptistaan. Osallistujat voivat valita eri matkojen välillä ja nauttia luonnon rauhasta ja vaihtelevasta maastosta.

name: Ultunamilen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott

description: For many years, Ultunamilen was organized by Upsala IF, but in 2026 it will be replaced by Gränbyloppet, held in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. Gränbyloppet focuses on the joy of running and safety in the area, with the start and finish near IFU Arena. The race is part of Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for young people and adults, on a course that runs through the park and its surroundings.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with 2.5 km laps (blue course)
The race is held alongside the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a visible race number. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held alongside Gränbyloppet for young people aged 14 and under. Results are published around the time of the race.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race that aims to highlight the importance of physical activity for mental health. The race is organised by the Mental Health Run association, and all proceeds go directly to psychiatric research. In Stockholm, the start and finish are at the Maritime Museum, and the course is an easy-to-run 5 km loop around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. Everyone should be able to take part, regardless of their background or fitness level—the event also offers a virtual option.

name: Kaišiadorių maratonas 2026
description: Kaišiadorių maratonas 2026 yra pirmasis maratonas, organizuojamas Kaišiadoryse, kuris vyks 2026 m. spalio 10 d. Šis renginys žymi naują tradiciją, suburiantį bėgikus iš Lietuvos ir užsienio. Maratonas vyks aktyviame ir sportiškame mieste, kuris garsėja savo sporto renginiais ir aktyviu gyvenimo būdu. Renginį organizuoja BK „Kaišiadorys bėga“, Kaišiadorių rajono savivaldybė, Kaišiadorių švietimo ir sporto centras bei VšĮ „Maratomanija“.

name: Bėgimas Gintarinė jūrmylė
organizer: Klaipėdos miesto sporto bėgimo klubas “Gintarinė jūrmylė”
description: „Gintarinė jūrmylė“ yra tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios nuostabioje Smiltynėje. Renginys siūlo įvairius nuotolius: 0,5 jūrmylės vaikams, 1 jūrmylę visiems norintiems, 3 jūrmyles moterims ir 6 jūrmyles vyrams bei profesionalams. Startas ir finišas yra Sporto sveikatingumo bazėje, o dalyviai vaišinami kareiviška koše ir arbata. Varžybų tradicija įamžina nugalėtojų vardus atminimo akmenyje, iškeltame iš marių dugno.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 7. Võsu Sügisjooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari on traditsiooniline jooksu- ja kõnnisari, mis pakub mitmekesiseid jooksuvõimalusi erinevatele vanuseklassidele ja tasemetele. Sarja etapid toimuvad Lääne-Virumaa piirkonnas, pakkudes jooksjatele kauneid maastikke ja meeldivat sportlikku kogemust. Võsu Sügisjooks on sarja 7. etapp, mis toimub Võsu Laine piirkonnas ning on osa pika traditsiooniga jooksusarjast. Sarja eesmärk on motiveerida inimesi aktiivselt liikuma ja nautima jooksu ning tervisesporti.

name: 71. Viljandi Linnajooks
description: Viljandi Linnajooks on traditsiooniline kestvusjooks, mis toimub igal aastal oktoobrikuu teisel pühapäeval Viljandi linnas. Jooks kulgeb ümber Viljandi järve ning on üks Eesti vanimaid spordivõistlusi, kuhu koguneb jooksuparemik üle kogu riigi. Lisaks põhijooksule toimub mitmeid rahvaspordiüritusi, sealhulgas lastejooksud erinevatele vanusegruppidele. Viljandi Linnajooksu rada on 10,4 km pikkune ning üritus pakub sportlikku ja meeleolukat kogemust nii harrastajatele kui ka profisportlastele.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

description: Hässelbyloppet is a classic 10 km race held in northwest Stockholm, featuring a flat, fast course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby. The race has a long tradition and is organised by Hässelby SK Friidrott. The same day, Lilla Hässelbyloppet is also held, a race for children and young people with shorter distances. The course is officially measured, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. It is a festive event celebrating the joy of running and great performances in a welcoming setting.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby
Lilla Hässelbyloppet, with shorter distances for children and young people
The course is officially measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Lilla Hässelbyloppet is provisionally scheduled to start at 11:00, and Hässelbyloppet at 12:00. Hässelby Idrottsplats is the event hub, close to the metro. Pacers are available for times between 37:30 and 60 minutes. Race bibs can be collected the day before the race. Drinks and snacks are provided after the finish. Timing is available from age 9, and results are published on the website.

name: Nummela BackYard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra on ultramaratonjuoksutapahtuma, jossa kilpailijat juoksevat 6,706 kilometrin kierroksia tunnin sisällä niin kauan kuin useat juoksijat pystyvät jatkamaan. Kilpailu on ainutlaatuinen, koska sillä ei ole ennalta määrättyä loppuaikaa tai -matkaa, ja voittaja on se, joka juoksee yhden kierroksen enemmän kuin muut. Tapahtuma järjestetään Polku-hotellissa Vihtissä ja tarjoaa haastetta sitkeydestä ja kestävyyttä arvostaville juoksijoille. Kilpailun juuret ovat Yhdysvalloissa, ja se tunnetaan myös nimellä "Just one more Loop".

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run in October offers evening trail races focused on the experience of light and darkness meeting. You can choose 5 km, 10 km or 30 km, starting and finishing at Väsby gård in Sollentuna. For the 30 km distance, you navigate using a downloadable GPS route and map, and there are energy stations along the way. Sign up— all proceeds go to youth sports in Attunda Orienteringsklubb.

name: 53. Saaremaa kolme päeva jooks
description: Saaremaa kolme päeva jooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus Kuressaares, mis kutsub osalema kõiki jooksusõpru. Võistlus hõlmab mitmeid distantsivalikuid ja vanusegruppe, pakkudes võimalust nii noortele kui täiskasvanutele. Registreerimine toimub kohapeal ning osavõtumaks on taskukohane, mis teeb selle ürituse ligipääsetavaks laiale osalejate ringile. Võistlus on osa suuremast jooksusarjast, kus arvestatakse ka hooaja kokkuvõtteid ja autasustamist.

name: Saaremaa Kolme Päeva Jooks
description: Saaremaa Kolme Päeva Jooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Iide külas. Võistlus koosneb kolmest etapist, kus osalejad saavad nautida Saaremaa kaunist loodust ja mitmekesist maastikku. Võistlus on avatud erinevatele vanusegruppidele ning pakub sõbralikku ja toetavat atmosfääri kõigile jooksuhuvilistele. Osalejatele on tagatud elektrooniline ajavõtt, korduvkasutatavad rinnanumbrid ja joogitopsid ning pärast jooksu magus amps ja jook.

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event at Hellasgården in Nacka, welcoming runners of all ages and abilities. The races pass through the Hellas area, by lakes and over hills along scenic trails and roads, with short courses for children and longer options for recreational runners. The youngest runners have a relatively flat course, and the event is designed as an enjoyable day with music, refreshments and award ceremonies. It is presented as a local, friendly family race with plenty of parking and cycling options.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a fun race in central Jönköping, suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners. Starting at Lillsjöplan, the races follow a completely flat, officially measured course, making it ideal for personal bests and seeding. Both 5 km (1 lap) and 10 km (2 laps) options are available, and the organizers emphasize a great atmosphere, with pacers for 40, 45, and 50 minutes in the 10K. Team registration gives a 10% discount when three runners sign up together, and group registration is available for larger parties.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run is a nighttime trail race focused on the experience and the magic of running in the dark. Dog Trail is a special category where you can share the evening with your dog over 5 km or 10 km, on courses designed for a memorable evening in the forest. The event emphasizes safety in the dark—the courses are marked with reflective markers, and a headlamp is required. All proceeds go to youth sports at Attunda Orienteering Club.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholms Brantaste is an intense hill race in Hammarbybacken, taking place on 17 October 2026. The race is just over 3–3.5 km long, with a steep climb and more than 200 metres of elevation gain, and is aimed at both experienced runners and beginners who want to challenge themselves. The finish is at the top of the hill, with a beautiful view over the city. The children’s races Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta are also offered, but registration for these may be closed at certain times.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026
description: Rönninge Backyard Run is a lap race in Toredal where each lap is 6.706 metres. The format features hourly starts: the first lap starts at 09:00, followed by a new start every full hour, for a total of up to 12 laps. Participants must complete a lap in under an hour to start the next one. The winner in each of the women’s and men’s categories is the participant who completes the most laps, with the fastest time on the final lap breaking a tie. The race suits both competitive runners and those looking to test their endurance on a technical yet runnable course through scenic Garnudden. A shorter MiniBackyard is offered for children and beginners, with on-site registration and a separate start time in the afternoon.

name: Vistakulle Backyard
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organised by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is aimed at people who are a little adventurous and interested in fitness, and places as much emphasis on the experience of nature as on performance. The event takes place on 16 May 2026 and offers a memorable course through hilly terrain close to nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baueractivities.se/loppen/vistakulle-backyard/): 2026-10-17 — "17 Oktober 2026 07.00-19.00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas
description: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas yra unikalus bekelės bėgimo renginys, kuriame bėgikai kas valandą turi įveikti 6,7 km ratą tol, kol lieka paskutinis stovintis. Varžybos vyksta kalnuotose ir bekelės trasose, kurios reikalauja ištvermės ir valios. Renginys yra iššūkis tiek fizinei, tiek psichologinei ištvermei, o nugalėtojas visada yra tik vienas. Trailo Kalvė organizuoja šį renginį su ypatingu dėmesiu trasų kokybei ir dalyvių patirčiai, kviesdama bėgikus išbandyti save ir įveikti save pačius.

name: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė
description: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė yra tradicinis Kelmės rajono bėgimas, skirtas Vaidoto Rimkaus atminimui. Varžybos vyksta spalio mėnesį ir siekia populiarinti bėgimą bei lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje, skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir didinti rajono gyventojų aktyvumą. Renginys pritraukia įvairaus amžiaus bėgikus, o dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų, įskaitant 8 km pagrindinį bėgimą. Varžybų metu dalyviai apdovanojami taurėmis, medaliais ir atminimo prizais.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail to cykl biegów trailowych odbywających się na pagórkowatych szlakach Pomorza i Kaszub z bazą zawodów w KJ Barłomino. W ramach imprezy dostępnych jest pięć dystansów: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km oraz 11 km, oferujących różnorodne wyzwania dla biegaczy terenowych. Zawody promują piękno kaszubskich terenów oraz regionalne atrakcje, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na doskonałe bufety na trasie. Impreza jest wspierana przez program #AktywnaWieś i organizowana przez Stowarzyszenie Pomerania Sports.

name: Pomerania Ultra-Trail®
description: Pomerania Ultra-Trail® to cykl biegów trailowych odbywających się na pagórkowatych szlakach Pomorza i Kaszub, z bazą zawodów w KJ Barłomino. W ramach imprezy dostępnych jest pięć dystansów: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km oraz 11 km, oferujących różnorodne wyzwania dla biegaczy terenowych. Zawody promują piękno kaszubskich terenów oraz regionalne atrakcje, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na dobrze przygotowane bufety na trasie. Impreza jest wspierana przez program #AktywnaWieś i organizowana przez Stowarzyszenie Pomerania Sports.

name: Krusensterni jooks
description: Krusensterni Jooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Purila bussipeatusest startides ja Hagudi mõisas finišeerides. Jooksu pikkus on 4,2 km ning see sobib nii õpilastele, pensionäridele kui ka täiskasvanutele. Võistlusel autasustatakse parimaid mehi ja naisi ning eriauhindu saavad veteraniklassi sportlased, noorim ja vanim lõpetaja ning suurim pere. Osavõtt toimub omal riisikol ning kõigile lõpetajatele pakutakse vett, maiustust ja kuuma teed.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is a fast, easy-to-run half marathon in scenic surroundings, starting and finishing at Näsby Castle. The course offers coastal views along the shores of Värtan, a scenic loop around Lake Rönninge, and a finish back by the sea with views towards Bogesundlandet. The course is officially measured and the race is organized by Täby IS Friidrott. It is ideal for runners looking to end the season on a fast and beautiful course. The race has been very popular in previous years, with limited places, so the organizers encourage early registration.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen—perhaps autumn’s fastest officially measured 10K, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on cycle paths and footpaths and is fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for those chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.

name: Pukinmaki Run Helsinki 18.10.2026
description: Pukinmäki Run on vuosittain Helsingissä Pukinmäen kaupunginosassa järjestettävä juoksutapahtuma, joka tarjoaa matkoja 1 km lapsille, 5 km, 10 km ja puolimaratonin. Reitti on tasainen ja nopea, pääosin asfalttia ja ulkoiluteitä, ja se kiertää Pukinmäen rajoja. Tapahtuma on avoin kaikenikäisille ja -tasoisille juoksijoille, ja se tarjoaa mahdollisuuden nauttia liikunnasta ja kauniista luonnosta yhdessä muiden kanssa. Kisakeskus sijaitsee Pukinmäen urheilupuistossa, ja tapahtumassa on tarjolla virvokkeita ja välipaloja.

name: Emili jookseb
description: Emili jookseb on sügisesel ajal Kadrioru pargis toimuv rõõmsameelne koolipere jooksuüritus, kus osalevad nii õpilased, õpetajad kui ka lapsevanemad. Ürituse fookus on liikumisrõõmul ja üksteise toetamisel, mitte kiirusel. See traditsiooniline sündmus loob ühtehoidvustunnet ja pakub kogukonnale meeldivaid liikumishetki värskes õhus. Esimene jooks toimus kuldsete lehtede keskel ja oli inspireeriv algus koolivaheajale.

name: 3. Holstre-Polli ööjooks
location: Holstre-Polli Sports Centre, Holstre, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: 3. Holstre-Polli ööjooks toimub Holstre-Polli Spordikeskuse tervise- ja suusaradadel Viljandimaal. See öine jooks pakub osalejatele võimalust kogeda metsikut loodust ja rahu, mis ümbritseb spordikeskust. Üritus on osa Holstre-Polli Spordikeskuse spordisündmuste sarjast ning sobib nii kogenud jooksjatele kui ka harrastajatele. Osalejatel on võimalik nautida unikaalset öist jooksukogemust kauni looduse keskel.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
location: Yxbackens slalombacke, Norrköpings kommun, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a hill race held at Norrköping’s own ski slope. The race is described as challenging—in 2024, participants completed five tough laps of the hill—and is aimed at both competitive runners and families, with a separate children’s race. E2C is the title partner, and the event combines competition, children’s activities, and award and photo ceremonies afterwards.
course_highlights: Held at Norrköping’s ski slope (Yxbacken)
In 2024, consisted of five challenging laps of the hill
The children’s race “Lilla Yxbackenloppet” was introduced in 2024
additional: The 2024 race took place on October 19, and E2C was the title partner for the fourth year. Around 50 children took part in the 2024 children’s race and received medals at the finish; the winners received wreaths at the award ceremony. Magnus Media took photos, which were published on the race’s Facebook page. Around 300 participants in the first edition; in 2023, the event was photographed by Magnus Andersson (Magnusmedia.nu); the children’s race Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C was added in 2024.

name: VSM terräng
description: The 2026 Swedish Cross Country Championships are organized by Västerås Friidrott and will be held at Rocklunda IP in Västerås on October 24–25. The course is an easy-to-run cross-country course over a flat grassy area, with a 2–3-meter-wide gravel path that is crossed several times per lap. Hay bales are used as obstacles on parts of the course. The event welcomes runners of different ages and abilities and offers ample parking, as well as nearby accommodation and lunch service at Good Morning Hotels.
course_highlights: Flat grassy area with less than 0.5 meters of elevation difference
2–3-meter-wide gravel path crossed four times per lap
Hay bale obstacles on parts of the course
additional: Pre-booked lunch is served at Good Morning Hotels, 700 meters from the venue, on Saturday and Sunday for 130 SEK. Book lunch by emailing henrik@vasterasfriidrott.se no later than October 16. Plenty of free parking is available next to the competition area. The VSM categories start on Saturday, October 24; the first start is at 10:30 a.m. Free parking is available next to the competition area. Pre-booked lunch is available for 130 SEK.

name: Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail
description: Welcome to the second edition of Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail, a unique and exciting running event in the autumn darkness of Kråksångsskogen. The race consists of 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with each lap to be completed in no more than 30 minutes. After the sixth lap, runners change direction, adding an extra dimension to the competition. A headlamp is mandatory, as almost the entire race takes place in darkness. This is a small-scale race with a limited number of places, offering a challenge for anyone looking to test their limits in ultrarunning.
course_highlights: 13 laps of a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes per lap
Change of running direction after the sixth lap
The course is marked with reflectors and trail markers, and consists mostly of trails with around 700 metres of gravel
additional: Food and energy are provided during laps 7 and 8 (pizza from a local pizzeria), as well as sweets, bananas, crisps, coffee, hot broth, sports drink and water. Facilities are limited, with self-service energy, a warm fire and shelter from the elements. Toilets are in the woods. Maximum 70 places. Each lap starts every 30 minutes, and if you complete a lap faster, you can rest for the remaining time before the next lap starts. The race starts at the Linghemsskogen barbecue area. Each lap must be completed within 30 minutes. A headlamp and mobile phone are mandatory items of equipment. Limited to 70 places; registration closes on 13 October. Participants who complete at least one lap receive a wooden medal.

name: Halloween Night Trail
description: Halloween Night Trail is an exciting and atmospheric trail race in the dark at the Karlsnäs area north of Ronneby. The race offers three distances: 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The courses are marked with reflectors and torches to guide runners through the darkness. After crossing the finish line, all participants are served a grilled hamburger and a drink, making for a pleasant end to the evening. The event has a Halloween theme, with decorations along the course, and encourages participants to dress up for an extra festive atmosphere. Ronneby Orienteering Club is the experienced race organiser.
course_highlights: Run on narrow trails and through terrain, with reflectors showing the way in the dark
Halloween-themed features such as Zombie Hill, Count Dracula’s lair and the Bat Cave
The finish area is indoors, and grilled hamburgers and drinks are served after the race
additional: Electronic timing for the 5 km and 10 km distances; no timing for the 2 km. Race bibs and chips can be collected at the venue from 17:00. A headlamp is recommended to help you follow the reflectors in the dark. The prize ceremony is tentatively scheduled for 20:45. Changing rooms and showers are available in limited numbers. Extra hamburgers can be purchased after the race. Parents may run with children in the 2 km without registering. Shoes with good grip are recommended because the surfaces may be wet and slippery. Electronic timing is provided for the 5 km and 10 km, but not the 2 km. A hamburger and a small drink are included in the entry fee. The venue and finish are at Friluftscentrum Karlsnäsgården.

name: Sporto šventė Juodšilių ruduo
location: Juodšilių, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The “Juodšilių ruduo” sports festival is a Vilnius District sporting event taking place on October 24, 2026, in Juodšiliai. The event encourages community members to take part in sports, promotes athletics and running, and advocates a healthy lifestyle. Anyone may participate, with distances of 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km. Participants register and collect their bibs at the event venue from 10:00 to 11:30. Participation is voluntary, and runners are responsible for their own health.
course_highlights: The course is in the territory of Juodšiliai Eldership, Vilnius District
Events: 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km cross-country runs
Walking animals and using personal support during the event are prohibited
additional: Bib collection and registration take place from 10:00 to 11:30. Participants must present an identity document to collect their bib. Participants may not transfer their bib to another person, use personal support, walk animals on the course, or leave the course without a judge’s permission. Protests must be submitted in writing within 30 minutes after the end of the event, with a fee of 30 EUR. The fee for changing an event is 6 EUR; changing to a longer event requires payment of the difference. Running events: 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km; registration from 10:00 to 11:30; participant awards and commemorative medals; participant restrictions and rules.

name: Pärnu Rannajooks
description: Pärnu Rannajooks on Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi hooaja ja kolmikürituse sarja lõpetav jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Pärnu Rannastaadionil. Võistlejatel on valida 5 ja 10 kilomeetri distantside vahel, mida saab läbida joostes või käies-kepikõndides. Rada kulgeb kaunis Pärnu rannapiirkonnas, pakkudes osalejatele nii loodusvaateid kui ka linnale iseloomulikke arhitektuurimälestisi, sealhulgas rannapromenaadi merevaatega. Üritus on sobilik nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele ning pakub meeldivat spordielamust.
course_highlights: 5 ja 10 km distantsid joostes või käies-kepikõndides
Rada kulgeb Pärnu rannapiirkonnas kaunite loodusvaadete ja arhitektuurimälestistega
Rannapromenaad merevaatega
additional: Distantsivalikus on 5 ja 10 kilomeetrit, mida saab läbida joostes või käies-kepikõndides. Võistlus on osa Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi kolmikürituse sarjast. Lastejooksud ja virtuaaljooksu distantsid on samuti kavas. Sündmus hõlmab ka virtuaalseid jooksu ja lastejookse ning toimub Pärnu Rannastaadionil, pakkudes võimalust nautida sporti ja loodust üheskoos.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is an annual running event celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026. It takes place on Sunday, 25 October 2026. The event website shows that the race has offered several distances (2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km, according to a previous registration form), and that the organiser publishes the invitation, race information, start list, map and results on the website. The website describes the course as scenic and the 14 km route as challenging. More information and course details are available via links on the event page.
course_highlights: Scenic course (linked from the event page)
Challenging 14 km course profile
Several distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km (according to a previous registration form)
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. The website includes links to the map and course profile, as well as race information, invitations, start lists and provisional results from previous years. A previous registration form (2020) offered a choice of distance and a choice of which day to run (23/10, 24/10 or 25/10). Content includes the invitation, race information, start lists, course map, results and course profile; 14 km course. The race traditionally takes place during the last weekend of October and celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026.

name: Löfstad Slott Trail
description: Löfstad Slott Trail is an atmospheric trail race held in the autumn darkness around historic Löfstad Castle in Norrköping. The event offers two distances: Lilla Skymningsloppet, a 1,000-metre children’s race in the park, and Löfstads Mörkaste, a 7-kilometre night race on gravel roads, trails and unmarked forest terrain, where a headlamp is mandatory. The course winds through the beautiful castle park and forest and is marked with reflectors and tape for a safe and memorable running experience. Löfstad Slott Trail is a perfect start to the autumn holiday week and is organised by Orienteringsklubben Denseln, with a focus on community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: 7 km night race on gravel roads, trails and unmarked forest terrain
The course is marked with reflectors and tape
1,000-metre children’s race in the park, with no timing
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 15:00 in the castle courtyard. On-site registration is available. Parking is available up to 500 metres from the castle; allow extra time to walk. Löfstads Mörkaste starts at 17:00 and a headlamp is mandatory. Trail shoes are recommended. Lilla Skymningsloppet is not timed, and children may run with an adult without registering separately. All participants receive a prize at the finish, and special prizes are awarded after the race. Löfstads Mörkaste starts at 17:00 and requires a headlamp; trail shoes are recommended. Lilla Skymningsloppet starts at 16:00 and is not timed. Participants under 15 in the 7 km race must run with a registered responsible adult.

name: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“
description: The “Around Lithuania” Run is a traditional running event held in Rumšiškės, on the grounds of the Lithuanian Open-Air Museum. The event offers a range of distances, from a 300 m children’s race to the 21.098 km half marathon, which is the main event and counts toward the Lithuanian Running Cup standings. Participants start according to age-group handicap rules, and the event program includes registration, starts for different distances, and awards. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors and compete with running enthusiasts from all over Lithuania.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 300 m children’s race to a 21.098 km half marathon
Starts follow age-group handicap rules
Location: Lithuanian Open-Air Museum in Rumšiškės
additional: Event program: 09:00 registration and race number distribution, 10:45 competition opening, starts for different distances from 11:00 to 13:00, awards from 14:00. The main distance is 21.098 km, consisting of 4 laps. The age-group handicap system allows less competitive participants to start earlier. The event takes place in Rumšiškės, with online registration available. The program includes starts, awards, and special groups.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: Sopot Half Marathon is an annual half-marathon held in the picturesque seaside city of Sopot. Participants can run a route through charming parts of the city, finishing at ERGO Arena, which offers a unique atmosphere and comfort. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering professional organization and attractive race packs. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of sport in the Pearl of the Baltic and earn a commemorative medal and T-shirt.
course_highlights: The route passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades
The finish is located at ERGO Arena
Picturesque views of the Baltic Sea and Sopot’s iconic pier
additional: The race pack includes an official T-shirt and medal. The half-marathon route is certified and passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades. The finish is inside ERGO Arena, providing comfortable conditions for runners after the race. Race packs available from 10 February 2026; participant limit: 3,500; discounts for holders of the Sopot Card; the event is part of the Korona Półmaratonów Pomorza 2026–2030 series.

name: Sõeru Kevadjooks
description:
Sõeru Kevadjooks on pühendatud ajaloolisele Sõeru silmaallikale, mis asub Vanamõisa
multifunktsionaalsel tervise- ja õpperajal. Jooksu eesmärgiks on jooksuharrastuse
propageerimine, võistlusvõimaluse pakkumine ja ka võitjate selgitamine erinevatel
distantsidel. Oluline on ka tutvustada piirkonda, pakkuda värskes õhus sportlikku vaba aja
veetmise võimalust kogu perele ning propageerida sportlikke eluviise.
additional:
Registreerimine ja stardid toimuvad Vanamõisa vabaõhukeskuses (Vabaõhukeskuse tee 20), Harjumaa, Saue vald, Vanamõisa küla. Stardimaterjalide väljastamine toimub 12. mail kell 17:00-20:00
Vanamõisa karavanpargi kohvikus (Vabaõhukeskuse tee 18). 13. mail toimub stardimaterjalide väljastamine ja võistlejate registreerimine alates kell 15:00 Vanamõisa vabaõhukeskuse palksaalis. Numbrite väljastamine lõpeb kell 17:15 ja lastejooksudele kell 16:30.

Lastejooksud algavad kell 17:00
Põhijooksu start kell 18:00
Noortejooksu start kell 18:10
Kõik stardid antakse Vanamõisa vabaõhukeskusest. Samas kohas on ka finiš.

name: Kopli Liinide Jooks
description:
Rada algab Kopli Liinide promenaadilt. Teekond jätkub läbi Kopli Käsepargi, seejärel mööda mereäärt.

Raja esimene pool kulgeb mööda mereäärt, pakkudes kauneid vaateid Kopli lahele.

Rada läbib ka Paljassaare hoiuala, mis on kaunis looduskaitseala ja tuntud linnuvaatluse koht. Seejärel liigume läbi Tallinna Vesi territooriumi, kus on võimalik näha, kuidas toimub vee puhastamine, enne kui naaseme tagasi promenaadile.

name: 24. Jooks ümber Võhma
description: Jooks ümber Võhma on kohalik jooksuvõistlus, mis kulgeb mööda Võhma linna tänavaid ja terviserada.
course_highlights: 5 km rada Võhma linna tänavatel ja terviserajal
Valdavalt kõva kattega, tähistatud nooltega asfaldil
Võistlejate ees sõidab jalgrattur, rada on avatud liiklusele
additional: Registreerimine toimub internetis kuni 24. septembrini aadressil timesport.ee ning jooksupäeval Võhma kooli ees kell 10:00-11:40. Ajavõtt on elektrooniline kiibiga, mis kinnitatakse pahkluu piirkonda ja tuleb finišis tagastada. Tagastamata või kaotatud kiibi eest on trahv 70 €. Osalejatele jagatakse medaleid ja toimub auhindade loosimine. Võistlejad vastutavad oma tervisliku seisundi eest ise. Lapsed lubatakse rajale lapsevanema vastutusel. Võistluse raames on võimalik registreeruda nii internetis kui ka kohapeal, ning osalejad saavad auhinnad ja medalid. Rada hõlmab linna tänavaid ning asfalti, pakkudes meeldivat ja motiveerivat jooksukogemust. Üritus toimub 26. septembril 2026.

name: SPORTLAND KÕRVEMAA METSAJOOKS  27. SEPTEMBER 2026
description:
Miks tulla Kõrvemaa Metsajooksule?

- Tõenäoliselt kõige ilusamad rajad keset ürgset loodust. 
- 100% rajast asub imekaunil looduskaitsealal.
- Turgutad oma keha ja vaimu.
- Tulla saab kogu perega, sest tegevused ja lastehoid on organiseeritud ka pere pisematele.
- Mugav ja kompaktne võistluskeskus Tallinna lähedal.
- Kõigile tasuta supp, smuuti ja muud üllatused partneritelt. 
- Loomulikult ka kuum saun ning julgematele ka kümblustünn.
- Võistlema võiks tulla ka koos terve töökollektiiviga, et parandada meeskonnavaimu ja tervist.
- Panustame koos eestlaste rahvatervisesse.

Kogu päev on avatud Sportlandi pop-up pood, kus saad oma jooksuvarustust täiendada, kui miskit peaks koju ununema või kui soovid rajale minna parima funktsionaalse varustusega. Igale lõpetajale kingituseks uhke medal, GRAM jook ja Nicks batoon. Võitjad saavad kingituseks Sportlandi krediiti, istiku ning kingitusi partnerite poolt. Tunnustatud saavad ka hooaja vanuseklasside parimad ning hooaja parim meeskond.

Tahad oma seltskonnaga nautida privaatset sauna? Rendi Iglusaun tiigi kaldal! Soovid ööbida Kõrvemaal? Uuri saadavust Kuuse Elamusmajades.
course_highlights: 100% rada kulgeb imekaunil looduskaitsealal
Maastikujooks ürgses looduses, vahelduvad tõusud ja laskumised
Rajad sobivad nii algajatele kui kogenud jooksjatele
additional:
Registreerimine toimub veebis aadressil iseteenindus.sportlandkorvemaa.ee või Sportose keskkonnas, kus ühe makselahendusena on võimalik tasuda ka Stebby`ga.

Võistlus toimub pühapäeval 27.09.2026. Võistluspäeval saab registreeruda stardipaigas alates kell 10.00. Registreerimine lõpeb 30 minutit enne starti.

eenioritele (vanus 60+) ja noortele (vanus kuni 17) kehtib 50% soodustust eelregistreerimisel põhidistantsidel. Soodustus rakendub registreerimisel automaatselt sünniaasta järgi. Soodushinna minimaalne suurus on 15 EUR, sellest edasi soodustus ei lange. Soodustus ei kehti noortevõistlustel, sest see juba on erihinnaga 15 EUR. Korraga saab kasutada ainult ühte soodustust, süsteem arvestab alati suuremat.

Registreerides korraga vähemalt 5 inimest rakendub soodustus 10%. Registreerides korraga vähemalt 10 inimest rakendub soodustus 20%. Kui registreerite samast ettevõttest, klubist või sõpruskonnast, märkige kindlasti tiimi  nimi, sest sarja lõpus autasustame parimat tiimi, kes sarjal osales.

name: Selveri Laste Rahvajooks Kakumäe 2026
description: Selveri Laste Rahvajooks Kakumäe 2026 on lastejooks Kakumäe rannas. Oodatud on lapsed alates 1-eluaastast.
additional: Iga suur sporditee algab esimesest stardist. Selveri Laste Rahvajooks Kakumäe 2026 annab lastele võimaluse kogeda oma esimest võistlust turvalises ja rõõmsas õhkkonnas. Finišis ootab kõiki osalejaid medal ning loodetavasti ka tunne, et nad said hakkama – just selline eduelamus, mis innustab liikuma ka tulevikus.😊

name: Selveri Laste Rahvajooks Uus Maailm 2026
location: Tallinna Humanitaargümnaasiumi spordiväljak, Koidu tn 97,  Tallinna Kesklinna linnaosa.
description: Selveri Laste Rahvajooks Uus Maailm 2026 toimub Tallinna Humanitaargümnaasiumi spordiväljakul (staadion).
additional: Selveri Laste Rahvajooks Uus Maailm 2026 ootab lapsi osalema alates 1-eluaastast. See on paljudele lastele nende elu esimene võistlus. Iga lõpetaja saab osalejamedali, sest meie eesmärk ei ole ainult finišijoon, vaid esimene positiivne spordikogemus. Soovime, et see spordipäev jääks lapsele meelde rõõmu, eneseületuse ja eduelamusena.😊

name: Swedbanki Tallinna Maraton
description:
Swedbanki Tallinna Maraton ja Tallinna Sügisjooks ootavad registreerima!

Eesti suurim jooksu- ja liikumisfestival Swedbanki Tallinna Maraton toimub 11.-13. septembrini. Tuhandeid liikumisharrastajaid kaasava sündmuse programmi kuuluvad klassikaline maratonijooks (42,195 km) koos teatemaratoniga, poolmaraton (21,1 km), Tallinna Sügisjooks (10 km), Nike Noortejooks (5 km), tervitusjooks ja Limpa lastejooksud.

Tallinna Maratoni võistluskeskus ja stardi-finišipaik asuvad UNESCO maailmapärandi nimekirja kuuluva Tallinna vanalinna servas ning tänavatel ja kergliiklusteedel kulgev rada läbib põnevaid paiku, andes Eesti pealinnast värvika ülevaate.

Läbi aastate on Tallinna Maratonist erinevatel distantsidel osa saanud üle 340 000 liikumissõbra. Eesti suurima osalejate arvuga rahvusvahelise spordisündmuse välisriikide osavõturekord sündis 2025. aastal, kui osalejaid saabus tervelt 93 riigist.

Kasuta võimalust ja saa osa Eesti kõige võimsamast liikumissündmusest!

name: Sarvilahden Maraton
description: Sarvilahti Marathon offers participants several different running distances, including the marathon, half marathon, and 5- and 10-kilometer routes. The marathon and half marathon follow the same route, with the half marathon completed twice. The event provides electronic timing, and the maximum time for the marathon is 6 hours. All participants receive a medal, but medals cannot be guaranteed for those who register late.

images.alt_text: Juoksija Sarvilahden maratonilla. Hyvä kuva kilpailusta.
Sarvilahden maratonin reittikartta Loviisassa. 41km reitti näkyy kartalla.

name: Pilvimaja Night Trail
description: Pilvimaja Night Trail is a unique trail running event held in the Vaasa area. The event gives runners the chance to experience beautiful scenery and the calming effects of nature in the dark, on a reflective-marked course. The distance is approximately 13 km, and the event takes place on Friday, October 31, 2025, at 20:00.

images.alt_text: Pilvimaja Night Trail Run logo. Polkujuoksutapahtuma Skatilassa, Suomessa.
Kartta reitistä, jossa näkyy polkujuoksureitin kulku ja etäisyydet.

name: Vantaan Kestävyyskierros
description: At the Vantaa Endurance Series, you can challenge yourself in five different events. The series is suitable for fitness enthusiasts and endurance athletes of all levels, and offers a great opportunity to try completely new sports. The Vantaa Endurance Series consists of Vantaa Ski Race, Vantaa Off-trail Challenge orienteering, Vantaa Triathlon, Seutula Loop and Vantaa Marathon. The events are standalone competitions, but together they make up the Vantaa Endurance Series.

images.alt_text: Suunnistuskilpailu Vantaan kestävyyskierroksella. Monet osallistujat juoksevat maastossa.
Vantaan ratikkareitti kartalla.  Reitti kulkee lentokentältä Länsimäkeen.

name: Fiskarin Halloween 10K
description: Helsinki Halloween Run 2025 takes place on 25 October 2025! The event also includes a children’s race, Kids Run Helsinki Halloween, with distances of approximately 450 m (for children under 7) and 900 m (for older children). The route is officially measured, and the competition has 5 km and 10 km categories for men and women. The best Halloween costume will be awarded a prize!

images.alt_text: Halloween-teemainen kuva juoksutapahtumaan. Musta linna, lepakkoja ja kurpitsa. Teksti: Halloween Hölkkä 5.11.2022.

name: Riston Hölkkä
description: Risto’s Run is held in Suomusjärvi, Salo, every year on the Sunday after All Saints’ Day. The event is named after Risto Nuuroks, a four-time World Championship medalist in orienteering who won silver in the individual event in 1978. Competitive and recreational categories are available for runners of all abilities, and the routes pass through rural landscapes, mostly on gravel roads. Risto’s Run will next be held on 2 November 2025, with the race headquarters at Sisumaja.

images.alt_text: Riston Hölkkä - osallistujia, juoksijoita hymyillen ja kädet ylhäällä.
Riston Hölkkä - juoksija juoksee kilpailussa, kilpailunumero 89.
Riston Hölkkä -juoksija juoksee hiekkatiellä, numero 91 rinnassa.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Rasepori
description: Fiskars Marathon Raasepori will be held on 20.06.2025, starting from the Fiskari Athletes’ lodge. The race starts at 10:00. The entire route follows gravel roads, offering runners a range of distances, including 15 km, 7 km, 1.5 km and 0.5 km. The event is a perfect opportunity for both beginners and experienced runners seeking a challenge and beautiful scenery. All participants receive a commemorative medal.

images.alt_text: Fiskarsin kylä lintuperspektiivistä, jossa sijaitsee juoksureitti.

name: Repovesi Trail 2026
description: Repovesi Trail 2026 is a trail running event held in Repovesi National Park on Saturday, 31 October 2026. The event offers three challenging distances: 10 km, 21 km and 42 km, taking runners through stunning natural scenery among rugged cliffs and forest views. The routes are clearly marked and feature varied terrain, offering a challenge for experienced runners and new adventurers alike. The event centre is at the Lapinsalmi car park, a short distance from the start of the route.
course_highlights: The routes follow the established trails of Repovesi National Park
Climbs, rugged cliffs and stunning forest views
The 21 km main route is run twice for the 42 km distance; the 10 km route takes a shortcut from the main route
additional: The event centre is at the Lapinsalmi car park, address Riippusillantie 55, 47900 Vuohijärvi. The race has a limit of 100 participants per distance, 300 in total. The finish closes at 18:00. Parking is available near the event centre. Runners must use their own cup at drink stations. Baba Foods smoothies, Maxim sports drink, sweets, crisps, bananas and raisins are available at the finish. After the race, a buffet meal is served at Restaurant Prinssi, with continuous bus transport to the car park. Route provisions include marking and aid stations; the event is environmentally friendly and offers prizes to participants.

name: Pohjoisbaanan maili 2026
description: Pohjoisbaanan Mile 2026 is a traditional mile race held on Pohjoisbaanan in Käpylä, Helsinki, on October 31. The race gives runners the chance to test their pace over one mile (1.609 km). The start is on the pedestrian and cycle path near Käpylä railway station, and the event is open to all running enthusiasts. The event is organized by Helsingin Juoksijat ry, and participation is free for members. Welcome to enjoy a fast-paced, community-minded running event!
course_highlights: The distance is exactly one mile, or 1.609 km
The start is on the pedestrian and cycle path near Käpylä railway station
The event takes place on Pohjoisbaanan in Käpylä, Helsinki
additional: Participation is free for members of Helsingin Juoksijat ry. The start location is marked by a Helsingin Juoksijat flag. The event lasts about an hour, from 11:00 to 12:00. The event starts at 10:00, and no information is available about specific course features or registration procedures. Helsingin Juoksijat also offers a variety of running training and community events throughout the year.

name: Komia Ilkan Polku
location: Ilmajoella Kyrkösjärven läheisyydessä, Ilmajoki, South Ostrobothnia, Finland
description: KOMIA Ilkan Polku is a varied and challenging trail-running event held in Ilmajoki near Kyrkösjärvi. The event offers several distances, including a 39 km marathon, a 20 km half marathon, a 10 km sprint, and the children’s Halloween Run. The route follows a variety of trails and village roads, with approximately 300 metres of elevation gain. The event centre is at Luontokeskus Käpälikkö on the shore of Kyrkösjärvi, where runners can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and challenging sections. The event is also family-friendly and encourages participants to dress in a Halloween theme.
course_highlights: Varied trails along the Ilkan Polku nature trail
Approximately 300 metres of total elevation gain
The route also includes approximately 3 km of village roads and gravel roads
additional: The event has mass starts, bag storage, and bag transport from the start to the finish area. The café serves coffee, sweets, sausages, and drinks. First-aid points are located along the route and at the finish. Changing facilities, showers, and toilets are available in the changing rooms at Kyrkösjärvi beach. Littering in nature is prohibited. The children’s Halloween Run is free and encourages participants to dress up in costume. The event includes various categories, the route, timing, prizes, a café, soup, bag storage, toilets at Kyrkösjärvi beach, a recommendation to have insurance, first aid, and the opportunity to test running shoes.

name: Vantaan Kestävyyskierros
distance_verbose: 100 km, Maraton, 30 km, Puolimaraton, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1500 metriä
description: The Vantaa Endurance Tour 2023 is starting! Sign up for the Vantaa Endurance Tour, where you’ll challenge yourself in five different sports. The tour is suitable for fitness enthusiasts and endurance athletes of all levels, and offers a great opportunity to try completely new sports. In 2023, one registration gives you access to five endurance events in Vantaa, allowing you to focus on training instead of searching for races.

images.alt_text: Hiihtäjä Vantaan kestävyyskierroksen reitillä.  Aurinkoinen päivä ja hyvin hoidettu latu.
Vantaan Kestävyyskierros -logo. Sininen tausta ja keltainen teksti.

name: Valon Kymppi
description: Valon Kymppi is a 10 km running event held every autumn in Jyväskylä. The late start, fading evening light and glow of the city lights along the Rantaraitti create a unique atmosphere for the run. The route has been awarded Finland’s most beautiful transport route. It is flat and fast, and the event centre is Jyväskylä Paviljonki.

images.alt_text: Valon Kymppi -juoksun lähtö Jyväskylässä. Juoksijat valmiina startissa.
Valon Kymppi -juoksija hymyilee ja näyttää peukkua Jyväskylän maisemissa.
Valon Kymppi -juoksija hymyilee ja näyttää peukkua Jyväskylän Rantaraitilla.
Valon Kymppi - Jyväskylän reittikartta. 10km juoksu Rantaraitilla.

name: Nevas Night Run
description: The Nevas Night Run 2026 event will be run or walked on 4 September 2026 in Kalkkiranta, Sipoo. Participants can choose between two distances: 12.5 km and 7 km. The longer distance includes two laps around Byträsket, while the shorter distance is designed for all runners. The revamped event also features new categories and a new start location, bringing participants new challenges and experiences.

images.alt_text: Mainos Nevas Night Run -juoksusta. Juoksija osoittaa banneria, jossa juoksukilpailun logo.
Nevas Night Run logo, jossa juoksijoita ja tähtiä pimeässä.

name: Finlandia Marathon
description: Finlandia Marathon is a running event held in Jyväskylä on 11–12 September 2026. The route follows Jyväskylä’s flat, fast Rantaraitti, which has been awarded the title of Finland’s most beautiful transport route. The event centre is Lutakonaukio and Jyväskylä Paviljonki.

images.alt_text: Finlandia Marathonin lähtö Jyväskylässä. Juoksijat starttaavat.

name: Finlandia Vitonen
description: Finlandia Vitonen is the shortest distance at the Finlandia Marathon and is open to everyone interested in physical activity. Participants can move at their own pace, whether it’s a fast sprint or a leisurely walk. The 5 km route follows Jyväskylä’s Rantaraitti, with the start at Lutakon aukio. The event also features fun, encouraging activities in the start and finish area and along the route.

images.alt_text: Finlandia Vitonen -juoksussa osallistujia. Hyvä kuvaus kilpailusta.

name: Vaasa Maraton
description: Vaasa Marathon will be held on September 6, 2025, at Kaarlen kenttä on Ruutikellarintie in Vaasa. The race start schedule is arranged for different groups, and participants must start their final lap by 3:00 p.m. at the latest. Participants can choose the marathon, half marathon, 10.5 km distance, or the Minimarathon, which is free for children.

WMA is excited to announce that RunInBucharest has accepted the challenge of hosting the World Championships for Masters athletes in 2024. The 2024 World Masters Athletics Marathon Championship will be held on October 13 alongside the Bucharest Marathon, offering a wonderful opportunity to enjoy running in beautiful surroundings, with the course passing the city’s most important landmarks.

name: Nuuksio Classic Trail
description: Nuuksio Classic is one of Finland’s most iconic trail-running events, offering a unique running experience amid stunning scenery. The race takes place in Nuuksio National Park and attracts runners from Finland and around the world. Participants can choose from different distances, including 42 km and 70 km, and enjoy superb courses, wild forest, and excellent organization. Join us on September 5, 2026!

images.alt_text: Maastojuoksija Nuuksion poluilla järven äärellä, aurinkoisena päivänä.

name: Orimattilan Kymppi
description: The most significant village event to develop in Kuivanto is Kuivannon Kymppi. As a celebration of physical activity, it brings villagers together in late autumn to exercise and organize a sporting event. This outdoor and sporting event, initiated by local residents, was first held in 1981, when 24 participants completed the course. The event has grown into a significant international gathering, with more than 500 participants from countries including Russia, Estonia, Sweden, England and Kenya. Through cooperation between the City of Orimattila and local village associations, the event has been carried forward one year at a time.

name: Matin Muistokymppi

The course is designed to be both challenging and enjoyable for runners of all levels. The event is aimed especially at fitness enthusiasts and running fans, and offers an excellent opportunity to enjoy the outdoors and good company. Participants can run or walk, and anyone who wants a time will be timed.

name: Laajavuori Trail Run

This exhilarating event offers stunning routes in the heart of Central Finland’s natural landscape—hills, forests, roots, and breathtaking views. Whether you’re an experienced runner or just starting out on the trails, Laajavuori Trail Run is the perfect way to challenge yourself and enjoy nature while staying active.

images.alt_text: Suomen lippu ja kaunis luontomaisema metsässä ja järvellä.

name: Kaisaniemen Juoksu
description: Kaisaniemi Run will be held on Saturday, 13 September 2025, with 5 km and 21.1 km distances. Registration for the 2025 event is now open – sign up here! description: Bladhin Run is making a comeback, and we will hold the race on 13 September 2025. This historic running event winds through the beautiful wooden-house scenery of Kaskinen and offers participants an unforgettable experience. The race features several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, a children’s run (500 m), and a rollator run (150 m).

name: Kohnan Lenkki

description: Peräkylän Ponnistus is hosting the Finnish Beer Mile Championships on Friday, 26.08 at 18:00 at the main track of Pirkkola Sports Park. There are two categories: Beer (Official) and Non-alcoholic beer, and both are unisex. The world record under international rules is 4:33.6.

name: Lasse Virén Hölkkä
description: The international 53rd Lasse Virén Fun Run will take place in Myrskylä on Sunday, September 13, 2026, at 12:00. Several distances are available, including a 10.3 km road race, a 21.1 km half marathon, and a 6 km fitness event and hike/pole walk/jog. Welcome to Lasse’s Fun Run!

name: 55. Pirkan Hölkkä 5.10.2025
description:
A jewel of the running season, the icing on the cake: this long-distance running event, held mainly on trails, takes place every year on the first Sunday in October.

The 33-kilometre route from Valkeakoski to Tampere runs along a varied mix of fitness trails, forest roads and trails. Around five kilometres of the route are on asphalt. In addition to the running categories, you can take part in a walking category, which is not timed. The event is organised jointly by Tampereen Taivaltajat ry and Valkeakosken Retkeilijät ry.

Pirkan Hölkkä dates back to 1970. The route has largely remained as it is today. In recent years, the average number of participants has been around 1,000–1,500.
additional:
You can choose from the age categories Women’s Open, N40, N50, Men’s Open, M40, M50 and M60. The start is at the Sahara sports field in Valkeakoski (Tallikatu 11), where the starting gun will sound at 9:30 on Sunday morning. Late registration at the start is available from 8:00 to 9:00.

The event uses gun time, measured from the starting gun until you cross the finish line. At the start, you can choose a position near the start line according to your target time.

The first 3 km of the race are on streets. For the next 3 km, the route follows the fitness trail in the recreational area as far as Leppäjärventie. After that, the route to Rutajärvi (11 km from the start) consists of varied forest trails and a short section of gravel road. The 3.5 km stretch between Rutajärvi and Vähä-Kausjärvi is on forest roads. Of the 5 km between Vähä-Kausjärvi and Taivalpirtti, the first part is on forest roads, followed by forest trails; after crossing Savontie, the route returns to gravel roads.
From Taivalpirtti onward, the route alternates between gravel roads and forest trails until it reaches the recreational trail around Suolijärvi. The final 3 km follow a gravel-surfaced recreational trail between Hervanta and Koivistonkylä. This section still has a few climbs that will test Finnish grit.

The Pirkan Hölkkä route is marked with blue flagging tape, directional arrows and kilometre signs. The organisers have aimed to include as many forest trails as possible. There are six refreshment stations along the route.

The finish is in Nirva, Tampere, in the grounds of Tampere Adult Education Centre (Kurssikeskuksenkatu 11). Paid bus transport to the start is available from the finish area and Tampere city centre, both in the morning before the start and in the afternoon after you finish. You can include transport and the soup lunch sold at the finish area in your entry fee by selecting these add-ons in our online store.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat venyttelemässä ennen 55. Pirkan Hölkkää, lokakuussa 2025.

name: Pirkan Kieppi 5.10.2025
description:
The jewel of the running season and the icing on the cake, Pirkan Hölkkä is a long-distance running event held mostly on trails. It takes place every year on the first Sunday in October. Together with TU38, we are organizing the much-requested shorter distance, the 14 km Pirkan Kieppi.

Pirkan Kieppi starts at the Pirkan Hölkkä finish area, in the courtyard of TAKK’s Nirva campus, at 11:30. On-site late registration is open from 10:00 to 11:00.
additional:
The route continues via Lahdesjärvi to Vuores, where it winds through the beautiful scenery of this neighbourhood. It then joins the traditional Pirkan Hölkkä route at the Vormisto aid station, from where runners continue to the finish together with the full-distance participants.

Pirkan Kieppi has two open categories, women (N) and men (M). Timing is based on gun time, from the starting gun to crossing the finish line. At the start, you can choose a spot near the start line according to your target time.

images.alt_text: Pirkan Kierros logo, sisältää juoksun ja muita urheilulajeja.

name: Paraisten lenkki
description: The Parainen Run will be held for the 50th time this year. Anyone can take part, whether they run to win or for exercise. The event offers everyone the chance to enjoy running, whatever their level.

name: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu
description: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu is a running event held in the Ilmaristen Metsäpirtti area. Several different distances are offered, including a 10 km competitive race for men and women and a 5 km recreational run. The event offers a 10-kilometre distance for different age groups and attracts runners from across Finland. It is known for its good organisation and high standard of competition.

images.alt_text: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu ilmoitus: juoksutapahtuma, tiedot, reitit
Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu mainos, jossa juoksijoita ja tietoa kilpailusta.

name: Lokakuun Kymppi
description: Lokakuun Kymppi is a traditional running event held in Tolkkinen amid beautiful autumn scenery. This year, a large field took part: a total of 223 recreational runners and 60 competitors completed the officially measured course. Eero Saleva won the men’s race, while Sara Kuivisto was the fastest in the women’s race. The route is mainly on asphalt and offers stunning scenery and an encouraging atmosphere.

images.alt_text: Kaksi juoksijaa kilpailussa juoksevat kohti maalia aurinkoisessa säässä.

name: Haaga Run
description: Haaga Run will be held for the ninth time on 8 November 2025 in Helsinki! The event is organized jointly by Runner's High and FC POHU, with 5 km and 10 km race distances. The event features a mass start, making it a great opportunity for running enthusiasts.

images.alt_text: Haaga Run -juoksun voittajat, iloisia ja medaljit kaulassa.

name: NUTS HEL
description: NUTS HEL is an urban trail running event in Helsinki's Central Park, with three different distances: 6 km, 14 km and 25 km. The event is suitable for both first-timers and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Eläintarha Sports Field, and the longest route takes runners along the trails of the Haltiala Forest Nature Reserve. On Friday evening, NUTS Kids & Juniors is also held for the family's youngest trail runners!

name: Esi-Teivocup
description: Teivocup is a winter-season test run series held around Teivo Racecourse once a month from November to April. Each race is 5 km, with men’s and women’s categories. The event is for all fitness enthusiasts, whether recreational joggers, competitive runners or marathoners.

images.alt_text: Talvinen juoksukilpailu, jossa osallistujat juoksevat lumisella radalla.

name: Hercules Trail Run
description: Hercules Trail Run is a trail running event held in Mustijoki, Porvoo, on October 11, 2025. The event offers races on routes of different lengths, including 2 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km, so there is something for runners of all fitness levels. The trail rally is designed especially for younger participants, and adults can safely run alongside the children.

Juoksukilpailu, jossa lapset ja aikuiset juoksevat.

name: Nummela Backyard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra is an ultrarunning race held on Nummelanharju. The race ends when only one runner remains. The race is run on the orange daytime course, which is 6.7 km long, and the blue night loop, which consists of two 3.35 km laps.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run is a running event held since 1985 that attracts runners of different age groups. Held once a month, the event draws 100–200 participants, and its scenic route winds through the landscapes along the Loimijoki River. Runners can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km route, which runs near Forssa city centre through the park of the old cotton mill. The event awards the best runners, and the most active participants in particular receive an annual medal.

name: Kotojärven Ympärijuoksu
description: Kotojärven Ympärijuoksu is a traditional running event held at Mika Waltari School in Pornainen. The event gives participants the chance to challenge themselves in beautiful natural surroundings, and the route is designed to offer a suitable challenge. Last year, 73 people took part, and more than 100 runners are expected this year across the different categories, which include distances of 14.3 km, 6.8 km, and 2.2 km.

name: Solvalla Trail
description: Solvalla Trail is a trail running event where the SAUL Finnish Championships are being held for the first time. All age groups compete on the 10-kilometre course, with a choice of 10 or 20 kilometres; participants in the longer race complete the loop twice. The route winds through varied terrain, mostly along narrow trails, and features impressive rocky cliffs, stunning coastal scenery and beautiful forests. The highlight of the course is an almost 75-metre climb to the top of Swinghill.

images.alt_text: Solvalla Trailin reittikartta Nuuksiossa.  Reitti näkyy kartalla sinisenä.
Solvalla Trailin reitti kartalla. Vanha reittikuva.

name: Kaarinan Syysmaraton
description: Kaarina Autumn Marathon is a running event offering several distances for different age groups, including marathon, half marathon, and 10 km races, open to both men and women. The races take place on an approximately 10.5-kilometre loop through beautiful, flat terrain in Kaarina and Piikkiö. A children’s run is also held, with the youngest children running an approximately 150-metre loop and older children an approximately 500-metre loop. All participants receive a medal, and the children’s run is free with no advance registration required.

name: Viikin Viitonen
description: Viikin Viitonen is an event open to everyone, held several times a year. This year, the event will be run on July 1, bringing runners together in the atmosphere of a summer evening. The event has set a new record with 106 participants, and the current maximum number of participants is 150. Advance registration and the entry fee cost 10 euros (incl. 10% VAT).

name: Kankaanpää Maraton
description: Kankaanpää Marathon is a versatile running event offering races over various distances, including the marathon, half marathon, and shorter distances. The event takes place in Kankaanpää and is known for its beautiful scenery and well-maintained courses. Participants can enjoy running surrounded by nature, and the event attracts both recreational and competitive runners. To celebrate its 20th anniversary, the event returns to Niinisalo School, Kievarinkatu 3.

images.alt_text: Kankaanpään maratonin juoksijoita metsätiellä. Hyvä kuva kilpailun tunnelmasta.
Kankaanpään maratonin osallistujia juoksemassa. Hyvä kuva kilpailusta.
Kankaanpään maratonin juoksijoita. Hyvä kuva kilpailusta.

name: Pukinmaki Run 1/2 Maraton 10k 5k
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki. The officially measured distances are 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The route follows the borders of Pukinmäki and is a flat road course, with approximately 85% asphalt, 10% compacted crushed stone and 5% running track. The course is fast to run, with an elevation difference of just 4.9 metres.

images.alt_text: Kartta Pukinmäki Run -reitistä, jossa näkyy reitti ja maamerkit.

name: Halloween Hike
description: Halloween Hike 2024 gives children the chance to enjoy Halloween without scary elements. The event takes place at Memphis Boo-tanic Garden and offers a safe alternative to traditional door-to-door trick-or-treating. Participants can enjoy craft activities, not-so-scary characters, and treats. Costumes are encouraged, and this year the garden has introduced timed entry, so it’s a good idea to buy tickets in advance.

images.alt_text: Memphis Botanic Gardenin kaunis puutarhamaisema, jossa on punainen silta ja rauhoittava lampi.
Halloween-aiheinen kuva, jossa on paljon kurpitsoita. Sopii juoksutapahtuman mainokseen.

name: Helsinki Halloween Run
description: Helsinki Halloween Run 2025 takes place on 25.10.2025 in Kalasatama, Helsinki! The event also includes a race for children, Kids Run Helsinki Halloween, with distances of approximately 450 m (for children under 7) and 900 m (for older children). Schedule: 16.00 Race office opens, 17.45 Kids Run 450 m, 18.00 Kids Run 900 m, and 18.30 start of the 5 km and 10 km races. Prizes will be awarded for the best costumes during the event, and a photo wall will be available for capturing the costumes.

name: Mustavuori Vertical
description: Mustavuori Vertical takes over the Mustavuori Ski Resort in Tampere on 28 October 2023! Participants climb the slope by walking, Nordic walking, jogging, bounding or even running. What makes the event special is that each ascent starts together at the bottom. The race is designed to be a challenging, communal experience, where the winner is the one who lasts the longest.
